Auf &ekronwerke.com&r stehen die Stufen,: &ekronwerke.com&r has the stages, the mod list, an installation guide, the most common questions and a &elive status page&r with the goals.
Auf Inferium-Ackerland fällt mit 20 Proz: On Inferium Farmland a second seed drops with 20 percent. Create's harvester harvests essence crops like wheat, then you don't even need the sickle.
Auf Kronwerke baut &eYUNG's Better Nethe: On Kronwerke &eYUNG's Better Nether Fortresses&r builds them bigger and more winding, with rooms of their own for the spawners. Share the coordinates in chat.
Auf Magma verbrennst du dich, außer beim: On magma you burn yourself, unless you sneak.

You get onto the server through the &9Discord&r: solve the captcha, then a streamer gives you a spot on the whitelist. &cWhoever leaves the Discord also leaves the whitelist.&r
Auf der Hitzequelle brät sie wie ein kle: On the heat source it fries like a small furnace. In your hand over a heat source works too. On the side, a decent melee weapon.
Auf die Podeste: &6Steinknopf&r, &6Redst: On the pedestals: &6stone button&r, &6redstone&r, &6clock&r. Source Gem into the chamber, &d2,000 Source&r.
Auf die Ständer kommen die Zutaten, in d: The ingredients go on the stands, a &6sapling&r in the middle. When it grows (bone meal helps), the ritual eats the tree and the ingredients and leaves the result behind. Every recipe needs the right kind of sapling.
Auf einem Setzling lässt er einen Baum w: On a sapling it grows a tree no matter how little room there is around it. That way the trees for the saw wheel stand close together in a row.
Aufgestellt verkürzt er Regen und Schnee: Placed, it shortens rain and snowstorms. Give it a sunflower in bad weather (right click or throw) and the sun comes back. A comparator next to it reports bad weather.
Aufträge haben eine Frist. Ein &6Dekret&: Bounties have a deadline. A &6Decree&r sets which kind of bounties a board offers. No board in the village? Build one from oak planks, oak logs, paper and a diamond.

Aus 27 Plätzen werden &e45&r, der Inhalt: 27 slots become &e45&r, the contents stay. With Create ore processing you have copper in bulk.
Aus Bruchstein und Lava wird Andesitlegi: Cobblestone and lava become andesite alloy, without any mine.
Aus Bruchstein wird Kies, aus Essenz wir: Cobblestone becomes gravel, essence becomes sand.
Aus Legierung entstehen Wellen, Gehäuse,: Alloy turns into shafts, casings, funnels and almost everything else in this chapter.
Aus Neptunium-Barren entstehen Werkzeug,: Neptunium ingots make tools, armour and Aquaculture's best fishing rod.
Aus der Kiste bekommst du die neun jeder: You get the nine back from the crate at any time. Saves space and looks good.
Aus doppelt wird &edreifach&r: ein Eisen: Double becomes &etriple&r: an iron barrel then holds 54 times three stacks. Tier 2 (fourfold) opens with the Messingwerk.

The electric motor, 64 SU per RPM.

The ghast cries when it falls.

The Copper Casing for everything fluid.

The milestone of the magic pillar.
The milestone of the tech pillar.
Der Messingrahmen, Gerüst jeder schlauen: The brass casing, frame of every smart machine.
The engine of the pipe network.
The Nether supplies what brass needs.

The plus button puts the ingredients in.
The price of the first brass.
The frame for the gate to the mining world.

The raw material for every Source Gem.

The stone for pools and altars.
The stuff magicians are made of.
The stuff journeys are made of.
The ammeter sits in series in the circuit. That way you see whether the generator sags under load or a wire carries too much.
The stator makes the magnetic field.

The part you hold in your hand.
The guardian of the trial chambers.

The only way to Source Gems.
The first step into Nature's Aura.
The first step towards the blaze cake.
Der graue Stein, aus dem fast alles hier: The grey stone almost everything here is made from.
The heated mixer can cook too.
The right hook for every catch.
The quick way back, free of charge.
Deshalb kommt der Motor erst nach dem Ge: That is why the motor only comes after the generator.

The shelf the stamp comes down on.
The work surface for knife and hammer.
Die Aufzug-Seilrolle hält an Stockwerken: The Elevator Pulley stops at floors.
Your base works while you chat.
The Bounty Board pays in emeralds.
Die Beschreibung steht direkt im Tooltip: The description is right in the tooltip.
The loot lands right in your inventory.
Die Blockhead-Küche und die besten Mahlz: The Blockhead kitchen and the best meals.
Die Bosse der Oberwelt in der Reihenfolg: The bosses of the Overworld in the order you can beat them. Best with two or three people.

The generator coupling, 32 SU per RPM.
The base for hand and mechanism.
The base plate for every upgrade.

The chamber can do more than gems.

Die Kohle fällt von selbst: The coal falls on its own
The war machine of the Nether.

The logic in every brass machine.

Die Upgrade-Basis in die Mitte, &6acht E: The upgrade base in the middle, &6eight iron blocks&r around it.
Die Upgrade-Basis in die Mitte, &6acht G: The upgrade base in the middle, &6eight glass&r around it.
Die Upgrade-Basis in die Mitte, &6acht K: The upgrade base in the middle, &6eight copper blocks&r around it.
Die Upgrade-Basis in die Mitte, &6acht S: The upgrade base in the middle, &6eight logs&r around it.
The dungeons of Dungeons and Taverns.
Die Verzauberung &dMana-Boost&r bringt &: The enchantment &dMana Boost&r adds &e+25&r per level, &dMana Regen&r &e+2&r per second and level. So learning glyphs pays off twice.

The rotating mass, 32 SU per RPM.

Die letzten Maschinen und der letzte Kam: The last machines and the last fight.

The most expensive machine of this stage.
Die vielseitigste Essenz: Block platzier: The most versatile essence: Place Block, Interact, Rotate, Delay, the rune chalk and later many relays and rituals.
Die übrigen zwölf Blumen mit ihren Zahle: The other twelve flowers with their numbers are in the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter.
Dieselbe &6Mechanische Pumpe&r, das offe: The same &6Mechanical Pump&r, the open pipe end into a &clava lake&r, &6Fluid Tanks&r behind it. An &6Item Drain&r in the belt also empties lava buckets from the mine into the tank.

Drei &6Dorfbewohner&r mit Betten in eine: Three &6villagers&r with beds in a small room, next to them a &6zombie&r they can see but not reach. The villagers get scared and call an &6iron golem&r for help.
Drei &6Eisenbleche&r, ein &6Eisenbarren&: Three &6Iron Sheets&r, an &6iron ingot&r and an &6Andesite Casing&r make the &6Mechanical Saw&r. Facing up it processes whatever lands on it or passes on the belt.
Drei &6Goldbleche&r, ein &6Zahnrad&r und: Three &6Golden Sheets&r, a &6Cogwheel&r and a &6stick&r make the &6Wrench&r. Right-click turns a Create block, sneak and right-click picks it up at once.
Drei &6Messingbleche&r, &6Andesitlegieru: Three &6brass sheets&r, &6andesite alloy&r, &6precision mechanism&r and &6brass casing&r make the &6Mechanical Arm&r. Before placing it, click its targets: once for &einput&r, twice for &eoutput&r.
Drei &6Podeste&r höchstens &e1 Block&r n: Three &6pedestals&r no more than &e1 block&r next to the chamber: &6iron ingot&r, &6seeds&r, &6dirt&r. One Source Gem inside, &d2,000 Source&r, done.
Drei &6Vorlagenbretter&r oben, zwei &6St: Three &6Template Boards&r on top, two &6sticks&r vertically below. Same shape as the blueprint.
Drei &6Weizen&r und ein &6Ei&r, formlos:: Three &6wheat&r and an &6egg&r, shapeless: &ethree wheat dough&r. Wheat and a water bucket work too.
Drei Flauschbälle in einer Reihe ergeben: Three Fluffy Puffs in a row make a &6Fluffy String&r. As a binding it brings Flexible III, as a cord +5 percent ranged damage at a slightly slower draw. Four in a square make &6Fluffy Fabric&r, five diagonally a &6Fluffy Feather&r.
Three rounds, then it drops off the belt.
Drei Schädel auf Seelensand beschwören d: Three skulls on soul sand summon the &cWither&r. Keep them until the server is ready together (next quest).
Drei Schädel, vier Seelensand, ein Nethe: Three skulls, four soul sand, one Nether star.
Thirty people, one world, seven weeks.
Drin leben Piglins, die &6Piglin-Barbare: Inside live piglins, the &6piglin brutes&r (gold doesn't distract them) and hoglins in stables. Every chest makes the piglins angry, even with gold armour.
Drück &eE&r für dein Inventar. Oben link: Press &eE&r for your inventory. At the top left there is a small &6book&r; clicking it opens the quest book. The chapters are on the left, the quests in the middle, and a clicked quest opens as text on the right.
Drück &eF3&r. Oben links steht &eFPS&r,: Press &eF3&r. Top left shows &eFPS&r, your frames per second. If they are low, the lag is on your side: render distance in the video settings to &e8 chunks&r, particles to &eDecreased&r, clouds off. That does more than any other setting.
Drück &eM&r für die Karte von &6FTB Chun: Press &eM&r for the &6FTB Chunks&r map or &eJ&r for JourneyMap. Both record everything you have seen.
Du brauchst ihn zu Hunderten. Später ver: You need it by the hundreds. Later a press over a basin compacts new andesite from flint, gravel and lava (quest &6Compact andesite&r).
Du brauchst sie für Vorlagen, für Repara: You need them for templates, repair kits, the modkit and the blueprint book.
Du brauchst viele: der Rotor will vier,: You need many: the rotor wants four, the electromagnet five, the motor six.
Du hast &e500 Chunks&r. Das ist viel, ab: You have &e500 chunks&r. That is a lot, but not the whole valley: a chunk is 16 by 16 blocks, and 500 are enough for a big base with fields and a factory.
Du hast eine gesicherte Basis, Eisen und: You have a secured base, iron, and you have already delivered something to the obelisk. That is more than most people have after their first evening.
Du kannst den Topf mit Inhalt abbauen un: You can mine the pot with its contents and set it up again somewhere else.
Du kennst jetzt das Buch, JEI, die Karte: You now know the book, JEI, the map, the rules and the keys. Everything else you learn while playing, and nobody expects you to know 230 mods.
Du siehst an der Truhe, ob du sie schon: You can see on the chest whether you have opened it already. Whoever mines it takes the loot away from everyone after them. Barrels, minecarts with chests and frames with elytra work the same way.
Du weißt jetzt, wie Kronwerke funktionie: Now you know how Kronwerke works: the server works together toward the obelisk, every stage opens for everyone, and this book shows you the way through every chapter.
Dunkles Feld, Fragezeichen, drei Zeilen: Dark slot, question mark, three tooltip lines.
Dynamic FPS bremst, sobald du woanders h: Dynamic FPS slows down as soon as you click somewhere else.
Ebenfalls aus den Handwerkseinheiten: &6: Also from the crafters: the &6Extendo Grip&r for more reach and the &6Wand of Symmetry&r, which mirrors every placed block.
Ecken &6Goldnuggets&r, oben und unten Mi: Corners &6gold nuggets&r, top and bottom middle &6sourcestone&r, middle gold ingot, &6diamond&r, gold ingot. Place it on the Arcane Core.
Edelsteine, Sockel, Zerlegen, Umschmiede: Gems, sockets, salvaging, reforging and world tiers are in the &6Apotheosis&r chapter.
Eggs and milk without chasing after them.
Eigene Wegsteine, Warpsteine und Schrift: Your own waystones, warp stones and scrolls are shown in the chapter &aExploration&r.
Eimer in der Hand und Rechtsklick füllt: A bucket in hand and right click fills or empties it. Create pipes can fill and empty it as well.
Ein &6Andesit&r und ein &6Eisen-&r oder: One &6andesite&r and one &6iron&r or &6zinc nugget&r into the basin: the mixer makes &etwo Andesite Alloys&r from them.
Ein &6Buch&r und ein beliebiger &6Setzli: A &6book&r and any &6sapling&r, shapeless at the crafting table, make the &6Lexica Botania&r.
Ein &6Diamant&r im Becken wird für &d10: A &6diamond&r in the pool becomes a &bMana Diamond&r for &d10,000 mana&r. A block of diamond becomes a Block of Mana Diamond for 90,000 mana.
Ein &6Eimer&r in der Mitte, &6acht Brett: A &6bucket&r in the middle, &6eight planks&r around it. 1x2 and 2x2 exist with two and four buckets.
Ein &6Einsatzgerät&r mit Setzlingen in d: A &6Deployer&r with saplings in hand replants at the saw carousel what the saw felled, then the tree farm runs without you. The Mekanism &6Precision Sawmill&r makes 6 planks per log and drops sawdust with a little luck.
Ein &6Einsatzgerät&r mit einer &6Schere&: A &6Deployer&r with &6shears&r in front of the sheep pen shears everything standing 2 blocks in front of it. In punch mode (wrench) with a sword it kills animals and monsters. The Reliquary &6Pedestal&r does the same without rotation: a sword in it strikes 5 blocks far, shears shear sheep.
Ein &6Eisen-Filetmesser&r aus zwei Eisen: An &6Iron Fillet Knife&r from two iron ingots and a stick. Knife and fish together in the crafting table: &6Raw Fish Fillet&r.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r oben, &6Kolben&r neb: An &6iron ingot&r on top, &6pistons&r next to the chest upgrade base, at the bottom &6redstone&r, iron ingot, redstone.
Ein &6Eisenbarren&r über einem &6Stock&r: An &6iron ingot&r over a &6stick&r. Gold or diamond work the same way.
Ein &6Faden&r im Becken wird für &d1 250: A &6string&r in the pool becomes &6Mana Infused String&r for &d1,250 mana&r.
Ein &6Faden&r oben in der Mitte, &6siebe: A &6string&r at the top middle, &6seven flax&r around it. Flax grows wild, you can farm the seeds.
Ein &6Gemälde&r und eine &6Werkbank&r er: A &6painting&r and a &6crafting table&r make the &6Crafting Blueprint&r. Hang it on a wall like a painting; every field on it is its own recipe.
Ein &6Generatorgehäuse&r (Eisenbleche, K: A &6generator casing&r (iron sheets, copper sheet, conductive casing) connects windings around a corner.
Ein &6Hebel&r in der Mitte, &6vier Stöck: A &6lever&r in the middle, &6four sticks&r top, bottom and on the sides: the &6Basic Tier Upgrade&r.
Ein &6Heuballen&r oder Reisballen, zwei: A &6hay bale&r or rice bale, two &6apples&r and a &6golden carrot&r, see JEI.
Ein &6Höhenmesser&r und eine leere &6Kar: An &6Altimeter&r and an empty &6map&r make a &6Slice Map&r. It shows the world as a cross section at the height where you open it, with all caves and tunnels.
Ein &6Klebriger Kolben&r oben, &6Faden&r: A &6sticky piston&r on top, &6string&r left and right of the upgrade base, &6three redstone&r at the bottom.
Ein &6Kolben&r oben, &6zwei Eisenbarren&: A &6piston&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, at the bottom &6redstone&r, a &6wooden chest&r and &6redstone&r.
Ein &6Kompass&r auf einem &6Andesitgehäu: A &6compass&r on an &6Andesite Casing&r makes the &6Speedometer&r. Put on its own into the grid it becomes the &6Stressometer&r and back.
Ein &6Kompass&r in der Mitte, &64 Holzst: A &6compass&r in the middle, &64 logs&r on the sides, &64 saplings&r in the corners make the &6Nature's Compass&r.
Ein &6Komposter&r frisst Samen, Blätter,: A &6composter&r eats seeds, leaves, saplings and plant leftovers. When it is full, it gives one &6bone meal&r. A hopper on top refills it, a hopper below takes the bone meal out.
Ein &6Kupferblech&r durch die &6Mechanis: A &6copper sheet&r through the &6Mechanical Saw&r gives four &6copper wire&r. Click a terminal with wire, then the next one.
Ein &6Leerer Lüfter Katalysator&r (Messi: An &6Empty Fan Catalyst&r (brass ingot and iron bars) goes in front of the fan. Right click with a water bucket, lava bucket or soul sand makes it washing, smelting or haunting.
Ein &6Leeres Pergament&r auf den Kristal: A &6Blank Parchment&r on the crystal gives a &6Scryer's Scroll&r with its location. Rename it at the anvil so you find it again more easily.
Ein &6Mahlstein&r hinter dem Bruchsteing: A &6Millstone&r behind the cobblestone generator turns cobblestone into &6gravel&r and gravel into &6flint&r, 250 ticks per piece. For &6sand&r put 2 &6Fire Essence&r and 2 &6Earth Essence&r diagonally into the grid: 16 sand. 2 Stone and 2 Earth Essence make 16 gravel.
Ein &6Mechanisches Lager&r, daran ein Ar: A &6Mechanical Bearing&r, on it an arm of blocks with &6Mechanical Saws&r at the tip, joined with &6Super Glue&r, saplings in a ring around it. When the bearing turns, every saw fells the tree it passes, leaves and all.
Ein &6Mechanisches Lager&r, davor ein &6: A &6Mechanical Bearing&r, a &6Radial Chassis&r with slime in front, &6Mechanical Saws&r all around facing out. When the wheel turns through a row of trees, it fells whole trunks.
Ein &6Messingblech&r aufs Band. Einsatzg: A &6brass sheet&r on the belt. Deployer 1 inserts a &6cogwheel&r, deployer 2 an &6Electron Tube&r, deployer 3 an &6iron nugget&r, then a &6press&r stamps it.
Ein &6Messingblock&r über einem &6Messin: A &6block of brass&r over a &6brass sheet&r makes the &6Peculiar Bell&r. Haunted it becomes the &6Haunted Bell&r: held or rung, it shows dark spots where monsters can appear.
Ein &6Netherquarz&r und acht &6Redstone&: One &6Nether quartz&r and eight &6redstone&r in the crafting grid make one &6Rose Quartz&r.
Ein &6Präzisionsgetriebe&r auf einem &6M: A &6precision mechanism&r on a &6brass casing&r makes the &6Rotation Speed Controller&r. It sets a large cogwheel above it to up to 256 RPM through its value panel, in both directions.
Ein &6Quellglas&r hält &d10 000 Quelle&r: A &6Source Jar&r holds &d10,000 Source&r. Sourcelinks fill jars up to &e5 blocks&r away, chamber and apparatus draw from jars nearby. Mined, it keeps its contents.
Ein &6Quellglas&r in der Mitte, darum he: A &6Source Jar&r in the middle, around it up to four &6Imbuement Chambers&r, each no more than &e2 blocks&r from the jar. Above each chamber a hopper with &6amethyst shards&r or &6lapis lazuli&r, below it a hopper into a shared chest.

Ein &6Redstone-Anfrager&r (Redstone, Lag: A &6Redstone Requester&r (redstone, Stock Link, iron ingot) places a fixed order on every pulse.
Ein &6Rohes Fischfilet&r und &6Seetang&r: A &6Raw Fish Fillet&r and &6kelp&r, see JEI.
Ein &6Schild&r mit Namen am Verpacker gi: A &6sign&r with a name on the packager gives its packages an &eaddress&r.
Ein &6Schwerer Kern&r über einer &6Böenr: A &6Heavy Core&r over a &6Breeze Rod&r makes the &6Mace&r. Its damage grows with the fall height, and a hit from a jump breaks your fall.

Ein &6Sender&r auf einem &6Messingrahmen: A &6transmitter&r on a &6brass casing&r makes the &6Display Link&r. &6Alloy, tube, alloy&r make two &6Display Boards&r.
Ein &6Smaragd&r in der Mitte, &64 Enderp: An &6emerald&r in the middle, &64 ender pearls&r on the sides, &64 Source Gems&r from Ars Nouveau in the corners make the &6Warp Stone&r.

Ein &6Trichter&r oben, &6zwei Eisenbarre: A &6hopper&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, &6three redstone&r at the bottom.
Ein &6Trichter&r über der Kammer füllt A: A &6hopper&r above the chamber refills amethyst, a hopper below takes the finished gems into a chest.
Ein &6Ummantelter Kettenriemen&r und ein: An &6Encased Chain Drive&r and an &6Electron Tube&r make the &6Adjustable Chain Gearshift&r. Without a signal it behaves like a normal chain drive.

Ein &6Werfer&r mit einer &6Schere&r dari: A &6dispenser&r with &6shears&r inside, pointed at a sheep: every redstone signal shears the sheep in front of it. A small clock or a button is enough.

Ein 3x3-Raster in einem eigenen Tab, das: A 3x3 grid in its own tab that works directly on the backpack contents. You put JEI recipes in with the plus.
Ein 5 x 5 Rezept für die Handwerkseinhei: A 5 by 5 recipe for the crafters: &616 andesite alloys&r, &64 planks&r, &61 stone&r make two &6Crushing Wheels&r.
Ein Amboss in einem eigenen Tab des Ruck: An anvil in its own tab of the backpack: repair, rename and apply books wherever you are.
Ein Amethystsplitter, 500 Quelle, ein Ju: One amethyst shard, 500 Source, one gem.
Ein Andesit-Trichter oben füllt ihn vom: An andesite funnel on top fills it from the belt, one at the bottom takes out. No filter, so one vault per line.
An arm that sweeps across the field.
Ein Aufzug fährt genau drei Stockwerke,: A lift travels exactly three floors, a gate opens by 90 degrees.
Ein Band von der Topftruhe am Lüfter vor: A belt from the pot chest past the fan into a second chest, done. The lava is not used up.
Ein Baum in einem Block, alle zwei Minut: A tree in one block, logs every two minutes.
A tree that turns golden over time.
Ein Bauwerk von Dungeons and Taverns gef: Found a Dungeons and Taverns structure
Ein Beet, das Quelle macht, während es w: A bed that makes Source while it grows.
Ein Bett, das im Nether nicht explodiert: A bed that doesn't explode in the Nether.
Ein Block direkt vor der Öffnung macht i: One block right in front of the opening turns it into a machine: &bwater&r washes, &clava&r smelts, &6fire&r smokes food. Soul fire for haunting needs soul sand from the Nether, so stage 2.
One block here is eight blocks up top.
Ein Block, der alles schluckt. Praktisch: One block that swallows everything. Handy behind a setup that spits out items and fluid at the same time.
Ein Boden aus Trichtern unter dem Gehege: A floor of hoppers under the pen collects meat, leather, wool and feathers. With the feeding trough next to it, the animal farm runs completely without you.
A bow made of living wood.
Ein Boot und Blöcke zum Hochbauen helfen: A boat and blocks to build up help with boarding.
A diamond into the full Mana Pool.
Ein Dorn oder ein heißer Wind statt dein: A thorn or a hot wind instead of your sword.
Ein Eimer voll alle 50 Sekunden, solange: A bucket full every 50 seconds as long as the chunk is loaded, and the cooking table takes the milk straight from the jar.
Ein Eisenbarren im Manabecken bleibt auf: An iron ingot in the Mana Pool simply stays there on Kronwerke. From stage 2, Manasteel only comes from Infused Iron.

Ein Festmahl stellst du als Block auf de: You set a feast down on the table as a block, and everyone takes a serving with a bowl. Shepherd's pie and honey glazed ham work the same way.
Ein Garten aus hellem Lebestein mit leuc: A garden of bright Livingrock with glowing flowers in between quickly becomes the most beautiful building on the server.
Ein Gegenstand einer späteren Stufe heiß: An item of a later stage is called &7???&r in its tooltip, with &cOpens in stage 2 (Brass Works).&r and &8You can carry it, not use it yet.&r below. You may pick it up and store it, but not hold, wear, place or craft it.
Ein Gold Leaf gibt 2 &6Gold Powder&r. Le: One Gold Leaf gives 2 &6Gold Powder&r. Lay &e16&r of it as a ring around an empty spot, as the book shows. Around the outside up to 8 &6Wooden Stands&r (Gold Leaf on a log).
A gold nugget for a friend.
Ein Helm, eine Spitzhacke und ein Hausti: A helmet, a pickaxe and a pet.
One click, and the backpack is empty.
Ein Komparator daneben gibt ein Signal n: A comparator next to it gives a signal by fill level.
A compass that points in the Nether too.
One chop, two strips of bacon.
Ein Käfig für eine Lohe, mit Magie versc: A cage for a blaze, sealed with magic.
Ein Lastenaufzug, eine Bergbauplattform: A freight lift, a mining platform or a drilling rig that eats its way down layer by layer. The elevator with floors comes in stage 2.
A delivery service on four paws.
Ein Mixer über einem Becken, darunter ei: A mixer over a basin, below it a Blaze Burner kept &csuperheated&r with cake. &6Two copper&r and &6one zinc&r make &etwo brass ingots&r.
One network for everyone in one colour.
Ein Ofen daneben macht aus den restliche: A furnace next to it turns the remaining logs into &6charcoal&r, the fuel for the Endoflames below.
A mushroom that counts as a petal.
Ein Rad liefert &d8 RPM&r und &d256 SU&r: One wheel gives &d8 RPM&r and &d256 SU&r (32 SU per RPM). Several wheels on one shaft add up their SU, not their speed. Four wheels on a stream are a solid start.
Ein Raum ohne jedes Licht, mindestens &e: A room without any light, at least &e24 blocks&r from where you stand, platforms with open &6trapdoors&r at the edges, between them a shaft &e22 blocks&r deep. Monsters take open trapdoors for floor, step on them and fall.
Ein Redstone-Signal schaltet ihn ab, wen: A redstone signal switches it off when the herd gets too small. Flower and pool are in the &aBotania&r chapter.
Ein Ritual für den Altar, ein Bauwerk dr: A ritual for the altar, a structure around it.
Ein Rohr daran liefert Wasser für Wascha: A pipe on it supplies water for washing, mixer or concrete, without any source in the ground.
Ein Schild blockt die Feuerkugeln, Schne: A shield blocks the fireballs, snowballs damage blazes. Position yourself so they come to you. The Mekanism Crusher makes 4 blaze powder from one rod instead of 2.
Ein Schild, der so viel hält wie sein Ma: A shield that holds as much as its material.
One cut, the whole tree falls.
Ein See in der Oberwelt ist endlich, die: A lake in the overworld is finite, the pump empties it block by block. Lava only becomes infinite with the lava ocean in the Nether (stage 2) or with fire seeds, next quest.
Ein Setzling jeder Farbe: rot, blau, grü: One sapling of each colour: red, blue, green, purple.
Ein Stück brennt halb so lange wie im Of: A piece burns half as long as in the furnace and gives &d3 mana every 2 ticks&r, so 30 mana per second. Then a 2 second pause. Its buffer holds 300 mana; when it is full, it eats nothing new.
A saw carousel for big trees.
Ein Tank im Rucksack, den du mit Eimern: A tank in the backpack that you fill and empty with buckets. Together with the &6Pump Upgrade&r (glass, bucket, piston, sticky piston) it sucks up fluid or places it.
Ein Team teilt sich die &eClaims&r (500: A team shares its &eclaims&r (500 chunks for the whole team, not per head) and its &equest progress&r: what one does is done for everyone. Each still claims the reward themselves.
A pond, a pipe, a tank.
Ein Topf kocht mehrere Portionen nachein: A pot cooks several servings one after another if you put in enough ingredients.
Ein Treffer reicht für einen Ghast. Das: One hit is enough for a ghast. At this distance it works better than any bow.
Ein Trichter vom Weizentopf oben in den: A hopper from the wheat pot into the top of the trough, and the supply comes on its own. A fence and a gate, that is all the pen needs.
One upgrade of this kind per storage.
Ein Verkäufer liefert, was im Netz liegt: A seller delivers whatever is in the network.
Ein Verlies von Dungeons and Taverns gef: Found a Dungeons and Taverns dungeon
A tool for the stone anvil.
Ein Werkzeug ohne Haltbarkeit bleibt als: A tool without durability stays in your inventory as &ebroken&r. Parts, enchantments and materials stay.
A tool that grows with you.
Ein Ziel, mehrere Säulen, alle müssen vo: One goal, several pillars, all of them have to fill up.
Ein abgenutztes Eisen- oder Goldmesser s: A worn iron or gold knife smelts into a nugget in the furnace.
Ein anderer Spieler benutzt den Kodex un: Another player uses the codex and learns every glyph from it they are missing. The codex is used up in the process. Ideal for a team in which one person collects the glyphs.
Ein brennendes Kolosseum in der Netheröd: A burning colosseum in the Nether wastes.
Ein echtes Netz mit Suche bringt erst &b: A real network with search only comes with &bApplied Energistics 2&r in stage 3.
A whole field in one breath.
Ein gemeinsamer Tunnel aus Bruchstein au: A shared cobblestone tunnel at Y 100 to 120 is usually quieter than the plain below. Coordinate with the others, and the server gets small.
Ein gezähmter Wolf, der es frisst, bekom: A tamed wolf that eats it gets effects for a while. Which ones is in the tooltip.
Ein gezähmtes Reittier bekommt davon für: A tamed mount gets effects from it for a while, which the tooltip lists.
Ein goldenes Blatt gibt mit 75 Prozent C: A golden leaf gives a Gold Leaf with a 75 percent chance. Keep the tree; you need Gold Leaf for each of the next steps and for the Source Keystone.
A hard core at the edge.
Ein kleiner Garten mit allen vier spart: A small garden with all four saves you many trips later.
A new material from two old ones.
Ein normaler Kompass dreht sich im Nethe: A normal compass only spins in circles in the Nether. The lodestone compass always points to its lodestone as long as you are in the same dimension. Put one next to your Nether portal, and you always find your way back.
Ein paar Dinge versteht sich von selbst:: A few things go without saying: leave other people's bodies alone (anyone can open them, see below). Thanks to &6Lootr&r, chests in structures have their own contents for every player, so there is no reason to empty them. Respect claims, even if there is a gap somewhere.
Ein paar Stapel &6Rohzink&r in der Truhe: A few stacks of &6raw zinc&r in a chest, and on opening day you are right in.
A rare catch from the deep.
Ein voller Eisensatz gibt 15 Rüstungspun: A full iron set gives 15 armour points. A leather &6lining&r brings Flexible IV.
Eine &6Andesitlegierung&r im Steinschnei: An &6Andesite Alloy&r in the stonecutter makes an &6Andesite Table Cloth&r. Click the seller at the Stock Ticker with it, place it, put the goods on top and the price below.
Eine &6Andesitlegierung&r oben, eine &6W: An &6Andesite Alloy&r on top, a &6wool&r below it and three Andesite Alloys in the bottom row make the &6Nozzle&r. Put it on the front of an &6Encased Fan&r.
Eine &6Andesitlegierung&r und eine &6Eis: An &6Andesite Alloy&r and an &6iron trapdoor&r make the &6Item Hatch&r. Put it on a vault, a chest or another storage.
Eine &6Andesitlegierung&r über einem &6g: An &6Andesite Alloy&r above a &6dried kelp&r makes two &6Andesite Funnels&r. On a chest, depot or basin it pulls items out or pushes them in.
Eine &6Elektrische Pumpe&r über einem Wa: An &6Electric Pump&r over a water block, power connected: it draws water up to &e80 blocks&r away without the lake getting emptier. The &6Basic Fluid Tank&r holds 32 buckets, &6Basic Mechanical Pipes&r pump 250 mB per tick.
Eine &6Enderperle&r oben, &6drei Obsidia: An &6ender pearl&r on top, &6three obsidian&r around the upgrade base, &6two redstone&r in the bottom corners.
Eine &6Enderperle&r oben, &6zwei Eisenba: An &6ender pearl&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, at the bottom &6redstone&r, a &6wooden chest&r and &6redstone&r.
An &6ender pearl&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, one &6lead&r each bottom left and right.
Eine &6Enderperle&r und eine &6Amethysts: An &6ender pearl&r and an &6amethyst shard&r make &e4 Warp Dust&r.
Eine &6Goldene Karotte&r oben, links ein: A &6golden carrot&r on top, a &6golden apple&r on the left, a &6glistering melon slice&r on the right, an &6ender pearl&r at the bottom, the upgrade base in the middle.
Eine &6Handkurbel&r und ein &6Zahnrad&r: A &6hand crank&r and a &6cogwheel&r make the &6crank wheel&r, a crank that meshes with cogwheels next to it.
Eine &6Holztruhe&r in die Mitte, &6acht: A &6wooden chest&r in the middle, &6eight planks&r around it. Every kind of wood works, it only changes the look.
Eine &6Holztruhe&r umgeben von &6acht Ei: A &6wooden chest&r surrounded by &6eight iron nuggets&r.
Eine &6Jukebox&r oben, &6zwei Eisenbarre: A &6jukebox&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, a &6redstone&r at the bottom.
Eine &6Kartoffel&r im Becken wird für &d: A &6potato&r in the pool becomes a &6Tiny Potato&r for &d1,337 mana&r.
Eine &6Lagerverbindung&r und ein &6Präzi: A &6Stock Link&r and a &6precision mechanism&r make two &6Factory Gauges&r. Tune them to your storage network and place them on the machine that makes an item.
Eine &6Lohenrute&r an der Werkbank gibt: A &6blaze rod&r at the crafting table gives two &6blaze powder&r. Blazes in Nether fortresses drop rods.
Eine &6Mechanische Presse&r über einem B: A &6Mechanical Press&r over a basin of lava compacts 2 &6flint&r, 1 &6gravel&r and &b100 mB lava&r into one &6andesite&r. A &6Mechanical Mixer&r over a second basin makes &etwo andesite alloys&r from 1 andesite and 1 iron nugget.
Eine &6Portable Lagerschnittstelle&r am: A &6Portable Storage Interface&r at the edge takes the harvest as it passes, an andesite funnel pulls it into your chest. With a &6Gantry&r instead of a bearing, the same machine runs back and forth over a square field.
Eine &6Schublade&r in der Mitte, &6acht: A &6drawer&r in the middle, &6eight obsidian&r around it.
Eine &6Truhe&r, Eisenbarren, ein &6Eisen: A &6chest&r, iron ingots, a &6block of iron&r and green dye, kelp or algae on top, see JEI.
Eine &6Werkbank&r oben, &6zwei Eisenbarr: A &6crafting table&r on top, &6two iron ingots&r next to the upgrade base, a &6chest&r at the bottom.
Eine Basis, in der man Dinge wiederfinde: A base where you find things again.
Eine Blüte ergibt formlos &e4 Magieblüte: One bloom gives &e4 Magebloom Fiber&r, shapeless. You need it for parchment, rune chalk, threads, robes and the Trinkets Pouch.
Eine Create-&6Kupplung&r und eine &6Ande: A Create &6clutch&r and one &6andesite alloy&r make the &6generator coupling&r. It is the base of every generator and sits on your drive shaft.
Eine Farm pro Quest, drei Zeilen Aufbau,: One farm per quest, three lines of setup, and it runs while you talk.
A hand that uses what it holds.
A crate with a hole in the bottom.
Eine Kiste oder ein Fass direkt neben de: A chest or barrel right next to the obelisk is a &efeeder&r: every two seconds it takes what it can use.
Eine Lohe im Käfig, und Create wird heiß: A blaze in a cage, and Create gets hot.
A million mana in one place.
Eine Monsterquelle, die du aufstellst, w: A monster source you set up wherever you want.
Eine Reihe Töpfe über einer Reihe Schubl: A row of pots over a row of drawers feeds the cooking pot, feeding trough and the Mycelial Sourcelink.
Eine Schere am &6Fortress Grouper&r gibt: Shears on a &6Fortress Grouper&r give scraps, on an &6Eyeball Fish&r an eye. Eye and blaze powder make an eye of ender, without any ender pearl.
Eine Silent-Gear-Spitzhacke ist ein &6Ko: A Silent Gear pickaxe is a &6head&r plus a &6rod&r. On top of that come &6binding&r, &6grip&r and &6tip&r if you want. Each part may be made of a different material.
One kind of fluid per compartment.
Eine Stufe öffnet für alle zugleich, ode: A stage opens for everyone at once, or not at all.
Eine Thermalilie am Lavatank aus der Feu: A Thermalily at the lava tank of the fire seed farm and a Gourmaryllis at the kitchen replace a whole bed of Endoflames.
Eine Truhe am Obelisken, die für dich ei: A chest at the obelisk that delivers for you.
Eine Vorrichtungs-Steuerung in der Kabin: Contraption Controls in the cabin become the floor selector. The pulley costs &d4 SU per RPM&r.
A crafting table you always have with you.
Eine angeklebte Truhe fängt das Holz, ei: A glued chest catches the wood, a &6Portable Storage Interface&r unloads it as it passes. Without a chest the logs fall to the ground, where hoppers collect them.
Eine ausgewachsene Kolonie erntest du mi: You harvest a fully grown colony with &6shears&r, after that it keeps growing.
Eine automatische Farm pro Quest: Stein,: One automatic farm per quest: stone, wood, fields, animals, monsters, lava and mana in stage 1, the stage 2 upgrades next to them.
Eine gesperrte Schublade merkt sich ihre: A locked drawer remembers its kind even when empty, so nothing wrong ever ends up in the iron drawer. &eSneaking right click into the air&r switches the mode (lock, counts, items, upgrades, fill level), &eright click&r on the drawer applies it.
Eine große Bestellung kommt oft in mehre: A large order often arrives in several packages, and other packages can slip in between. Route the packages into a storage, put the Re-Packager on it and give it a redstone signal.
Eine große Mahlzeit, die den Effekt Gesä: A big meal that gives the Nourishment effect.
Eine nach der anderen, für alle zugleich: One after another, for everyone at once.
Eine reine Magie-Basis vervielfacht Erz: A pure magic base multiplies ore here just as well as a pure tech base.
Eine verlassene Schmiede, in der etwas s: An abandoned forge where something sleeps.
Einen &6Mechanischen Schleifstein&r (8 A: Use a &6Mechanical Grindstone&r (8 andesite alloy around a shaft) on an &6Item Drain&r: a grindstone drain. A second grindstone on top grinds &6experience nuggets&r into &b3 mB of liquid experience&r each, the drain empties bottles o' enchanting at &b10 mB&r each.
Einen &6Monsterspawner&r mit einer Spitz: Mine a &6monster spawner&r with a pickaxe with &6Silk Touch&r (costs 100 durability) and place it at home over a shaft. It spawns up to &e4 monsters&r every 10 to 40 seconds as long as you are within &e16 blocks&r.
Einen Diamanten zerlegst du im Raster in: You break a diamond down into &enine shards&r in the grid.
Einen Dungeon von When Dungeons Arise ge: Found a When Dungeons Arise dungeon
Einen Eisenbarren auf den Altar legen, w: Put an iron ingot on the altar and wait.
Einen Ghast mit einem Feuerball erlegen: Kill a ghast with a fireball
Einige Rezepte binden die Seiten aneinan: Some recipes tie the sides together. Already in stage 1: the gearbox needs &6Infused Iron&r, the keystone &bMana Diamonds&r and &6Andesite Alloy&r.
Einmal anklicken, immer wieder hinreisen: Click it once, travel there again and again.
Travel once, free choice of destination.
You can carry them, not use them yet.
Eisen brauchst du ständig: Create-Teile,: You need iron all the time: Create parts, buckets, cooking pot, Silent Gear, iron nuggets for andesite alloy. Take copper along right away.
Eisen gibt der Axt -0,1 Angriffstempo. F: Iron gives the axe -0.1 attack speed. Flint makes it dangerous in combat with Jagged.
Eisen in Mengen heißt Klumpen für die Le: Iron in bulk means nuggets for the alloy, buckets and tools. &cCareful:&r Protect the zombie from the sun, or it burns on the first morning.
Eisen in die oberen Ecken, &6vier Kolben: Iron in the top corners, &6four pistons&r around the upgrade base, redstone in the bottom corners.
Eisen steckt in den Teilen für Create, d: Iron goes into the parts for Create, the first magic devices, the cooking pot and Silent Gear tools. Iron nuggets and andesite make &6Andesite Alloy&r, the material of the tech pillar at the obelisk.
Eisen und Feuerstein geben je +2 Schaden: Iron and flint give +2 damage each. Gold and copper enchant better (enchantability 22 and 15 against 14 for iron).
Eisen von Dorfbewohnern, die sich fürcht: Iron from villagers who are scared.
Iron, copper and gold get flat.
Eisen: +128 Haltbarkeit, +1 Tempo, +1 Sc: Iron: +128 durability, +1 speed, +1 damage, iron mining level. Gold: +6 speed. Redstone: +20 percent speed, +2 damage. Diamond: +256 durability, diamond mining level.
Eisenbleche, Wellen, Legierung und Andes: Iron sheets, shafts, alloy and andesite casing make the &6Rolling Mill&r (8 SU per RPM). A copper ingot becomes two &6copper rods&r, a copper sheet two &6copper wires&r.
Elektronenröhren stecken in allem, was b: Electron tubes go into everything that processes signals in Create: Mechanical Arm, Smart Chute, Display Link. On Kronwerke also into the first Mekanism circuit and AE2's smart cables.
Entfernt alle Trankeffekte vom Ziel und: Removes all potion effects from the target and sends summoned helpers back into their charm. On a &6witch&r at half health or less it gives &6Wixie Shards&r for stage 2.
Er brät bis zu sechs Stücke ohne Brennst: It grills up to six pieces without fuel and is the best heat source for pot and skillet. Campfire, lava or a magma block work too.
Er dreht einstellbar bis 256 RPM, trägt: It turns adjustably up to 256 RPM, supplies up to 16,384 SU and needs &d480 FE per tick&r at full speed. That way a mixer runs even without a stream.
Er erzeugt Quelle, wenn in der Nähe Tier: It makes Source when animals are bred or creatures die nearby, plus a little on its own for every baby animal. The babies grow faster. Next to an animal farm it works on the side.
Er feuert, solange das Ziel Mana aufnimm: It fires as long as the target takes mana, a new burst only when the last one has arrived. Long distances cost mana; the sparks in the aiming beam show where the loss begins.
Er gibt Geräten ohne eigene Klemmen eine: It gives devices without terminals of their own a connection and also feeds FE machines, such as Mekanism's, from your grid.
Er hat &e80 Leben&r und Rüstung 12, schi: It has &e80 health&r and armour 12, shoots burning bones and spits ash. Shield up and stay on it.
Er hält 3 Minuten, mit Redstone 8. Der B: It lasts 3 minutes, with redstone 8. The brewing stand runs on blaze powder. A stack of them belongs in your bag for every longer trip.
It hangs from the ceiling, often over lava.
Er kommt in einen &eRing-Slot&r (Curios): It goes into a &ering slot&r (Curios) and carries the traits of its metal. What a metal brings is in the &6Material Book&r. Bracelet and necklace follow the same principle.
Er nimmt beliebig viele Quellen und Ziel: It takes any number of sources and targets. An &6item scroll&r in its hand or in a frame on the chest filters what it touches.
Er reicht &e5 Blöcke&r weit und bedient: It reaches &e5 blocks&r and serves depots, belts, chests, basins, Blaze Burners and crafters. It costs &d2 SU per RPM&r.
Er sammelt Items vom Boden, erntet Quell: It collects items from the ground, harvests Sourceberries and carries items from chest to chest. No Source, no food. A second charm on the same Starbuncle stacks it: it then carries several stacks.
Er sättigt und macht dich beim Abbauen s: It fills you up and makes you faster at mining, ideal for long building evenings.
It carries a Totem of Undying.
Er verzaubert auch Werkzeuge und Rüstung: It also enchants tools and armour directly, up to Mana Boost and Mana Regen. JEI shows every recipe.
Er verzaubert mit &bFlüssiger Erfahrung&: It enchants with &bliquid experience&r instead of levels, without lapis, up to level 30. More in &6Create: Addons&r.
Er verzehrt Essen in der Nähe oder auf P: It eats food nearby or on pedestals next to it; nourishing food gives more, Sourceberry food much more. It turns the ground in the 3x3 below it into mycelium and grows mushrooms.
It shows you the way to any biome.
Er zerlegt eingesammelte Mystische Blume: It breaks collected Mystical Flowers down into petals right away and also holds Shimmering Mushrooms. A sneaking right click switches collecting on and off.
Er zweigt von durchlaufenden Stapeln ein: It splits single items off passing stacks onto belts or funnels next to it. Only the Brass Tunnel can sort on purpose.
Erfahrungsklumpen fallen aus Roherz zwis: Experience nuggets drop from raw ore between the crushing wheels. The &6Experience Hatch&r (fluid hatch and block of experience) on the tank is your bank: right click pays in levels, sneaking takes them out again.
Erfahrungsklumpen werden zu &bFlüssiger: Experience nuggets become &bliquid experience&r, enchanted items lose their enchantments to the drain. On the side it polishes rose quartz.
Erledigt sich über den Fortschritt &eHei: Completes through the &eHot Tourist Destinations&r advancement. The Biomes O' Plenty biomes don't count for it.
Erleg &e3 Hoglins&r im Karmesinwald. Sie: Kill &e3 hoglins&r in the crimson forest. They drop pork and leather and are the only real food source down here.
Erleg &e5 Lohen&r an ihrem Spawner und b: Kill &e5 blazes&r at their spawner and bring &e8 blaze rods&r along. Each blaze drops up to one rod, Looting more.
Erleg Ghasts, bis du &e2 Ghasttränen&r h: Kill ghasts until you have &e2 ghast tears&r. Easiest with the bow, or hit their fireballs back.
Erleg Witherskelette, bis einer seinen &: Kill wither skeletons until one drops its &6skull&r. Looting helps.
Erleg ein &6Schwein&r mit einem Küchenme: Kill a &6pig&r with a kitchen knife. It drops &6ham&r.
Erleg eine &bBöe&r. Sie springt herum un: Kill a &bBreeze&r. It jumps around and shoots &6wind charges&r that knock you back. It deflects arrows, so get close.
Erleg einen &3Großen Wächter&r im Ozeanm: Kill an &3Elder Guardian&r in the ocean monument. Every monument has three, and as long as one lives, it paralyses you again and again with Mining Fatigue.
Erleg einen &6Ghast&r mit seinem eigenen: Kill a &6ghast&r with its own fireball. Hit the fireball at the right moment with your hand, the sword or an arrow, and it flies back.
Erleg einen &6Ignited Revenant&r in der: Kill an &6Ignited Revenant&r in the arena. It drops &6Burning Ashes&r, the key for Ignis.
Erleg einen &cMagier&r. Er wohnt in Wald: Kill an &cEvoker&r. It lives in woodland mansions and comes in the later waves of a raid on a village.
Erleg einen &cMimic&r. Er sieht aus wie: Kill a &cMimic&r. It looks like a chest until you try to open it, and then it strikes hard.
Erleg einen &cPiglin-Barbaren&r. Sie bew: Kill a &cpiglin brute&r. They guard the bastions with golden axes, attack you despite gold armour and don't come back once dead.
Erntet Pflanzen, Gras und Blumen um den: Harvests plants, grass and flowers around the block you hit. Handy for the Farmer's Delight fields.
Erreich ein schwebendes Bauwerk von When: Reach a floating When Dungeons Arise structure and tick this off: a small airship or one of the three sky fortresses (Heavenly Rider, Challenger, Conqueror).
Only all four pieces bring the bonus.
Erst die Quelle anklicken, dann das Ziel: Click the source first, then the target. Sneaking on a helper resets it.
Erst genau eine &aForm&r (wie), dann &aE: First exactly one &aform&r (how), then &aeffects&r (what), behind each link &aaugments&r (how strong). It reads from left to right.
Erst mit allen vier Teilen kosten Werkze: Only with all four pieces do Botania's tools and rods cost much less mana, and the rods get stronger. Anyone who works a lot with rods is best off wearing this robe.
Erzeugende Blumen verbrauchen etwas und: Generating flowers consume something and turn it into &dmana&r. They pass it on to the nearest &6Mana Spreader&r, which they bind to on their own when planted.
Es fliegt zur nächsten &6Burning Arena&r: It flies to the nearest &6Burning Arena&r. That only stands in the &eNether wastes&r. Follow it until you are inside.
Es füttert dich aus dem Rucksack, sobald: It feeds you from the backpack as soon as you are hungry and picks food that won't be wasted. A few stacks from Farmer's Delight last a long time.
Es kostet keine Belastbarkeit. Damit sch: It costs no capacity. With it a lever switches a press from gentle mode to full power.
Es listet jedes Material mit Haltbarkeit: It lists every material with durability, speed, damage and traits and sorts by them. In the inventory, &eCtrl&r over a material shows the same stats.
Es presst Items, die ein 2x2-Rezept habe: It presses items with a 2x2 recipe into a block right away, for example clay balls or quartz. 3x3 recipes like nuggets into ingots need the advanced version from stage 2.
Es saugt Items auf, die vor der eingeste: It sucks up items lying in front of the set side. Good under cacti, sugar cane or a mob trap.
Es schiebt so schnell, wie der Puller zi: It pushes into the block next to it as fast as the Puller pulls. A drawer full of coal supplies furnaces or a belt that way. Create funnels work without an upgrade too; drawers are normal inventories.
Es steckt in Adapter, Elektromagnet, Mot: It goes into adapter, electromagnet, motor, meters and generator casing.
Es zieht aus dem Block &eüber&r dem Lage: It pulls from the block &eabove&r the storage and pushes into the block &ebelow&r, each direction with its own filter. Under a farm it collects the harvest, and only the seeds go on down.
Etwas langsamer als die einzelnen Werkze: A bit slower than the single tools, but saves two hotbar slots.
Faden gibt Flexibel I, Flachsstrang Flex: String gives Flexible I, Flax String Flexible III and +5 percent speed, Sinew Fiber Flexible IV. Vines only give looks.
Faden spannt 10 Prozent schneller, Sehne: String draws 10 percent faster, Sinew Fiber gives +20 percent ranged damage.
Farmer's Delight, Farming for Blockheads: Farmer's Delight, Farming for Blockheads and Aquaculture: meals that keep you full for a long time, rich soil, animals and fishing.
Fasst &e32&r Einheiten und repariert mit: Holds &e32&r units and repairs at &e40 percent&r. For hammer and paxel, which wear a lot.
Fast jede Maschine dieser Stufe braucht: Almost every machine of this stage needs something from here: &6blaze rods&r for the Blaze Burner, &6Nether quartz&r for electron tubes, &6glowstone&r for the Aether portal, &6magma&r and Nether bricks for the blast furnace.
Fast jeder große Mod bringt sein eigenes: Almost every big mod comes with its own handbook.
Fast jedes Rezept in Botania ist eine Li: Almost every recipe in Botania is a list of petals. You need white right away, brown, red and light grey shortly after.
Fertige Quests klickst du an und holst d: Click finished quests to claim the reward. How the book, JEI and the map work is in the chapter &6Tips and Tricks&r.
Finished quests glow until you click them.
Fest aufgestellt ist er das Herz eines B: Placed in one spot it is the heart of a cobblestone generator. On a piston, bearing or gantry it becomes a tunnel borer.
Filter und Stückzahlen kann erst die Mes: Filters and stack sizes only come with the Brass Funnel in stage 2.
Finde ein &6Höhlenlager&r von Artifacts: Find an Artifacts &6campsite&r and tick this off. It lies in caves between &eY -60 and 40&r, with light and a chest.
Find an &6ocean monument&r and tick this off. &6YUNG's Better Ocean Monuments&r builds it bigger and more varied.
Finde ein Bauwerk von When Dungeons Aris: Find a When Dungeons Arise structure at sea and tick this off: Undead Pirate Ship, Illager Corsair or Galley, the &6Typhon&r, a lighthouse or a fishing hut.
Finde ein Dorf in einem Biom, das in Van: Find a village in a biome that has none in vanilla and tick this off: beach, birch forest, flower forest, jungle, meadow, mushroom island, swamp, badlands and more.
Finde ein Dorf und hak ab. Dorfbewohner: Find a village and tick this off. Villagers trade for &6emeralds&r, which you need for the Warp Stone, the Market and taverns.
Finde ein Verlies von &6YUNG's Better Du: Find a dungeon from &6YUNG's Better Dungeons&r and tick this off: skeleton dungeons, zombie dungeons, spider caves or small dungeons.
Finde ein kleines Bauwerk von &6Formatio: Find a small structure from &6Formations Overworld&r or &6Explorify&r and tick this off.
Finde eine &6Bastionsruine&r aus Schwarz: Find a &6bastion remnant&r of blackstone and bring a &6gilded blackstone&r along.
Finde eine &6Prüfungskammer&r aus Kupfer: Find a &6trial chamber&r of copper and tuff and defeat the waves of a &6Trial Spawner&r. It ejects a &6Trial Key&r as it does.
Finde eine alte Mine und hak ab. &6YUNG': Find an old mineshaft and tick this off. &6YUNG's Better Mineshafts&r builds them from different wood and stone depending on the biome, with ore veins, storage and minecarts.
Finde einen &6Plünderer-Außenposten&r un: Find a &6pillager outpost&r and tick this off. Towns and Towers builds it differently in every biome, from badlands to snowy slopes.
Finde einen Dungeon von &6When Dungeons: Find a dungeon from &6When Dungeons Arise&r on land and tick this off: Foundry, Plague Asylum, Mechanical Nest, Keep Kayra in the swamp, Shiraz Palace in the desert, Thornborn Towers, Illager Fort or Windmill, Bandit Village, Monastery.
Finde einen Wüstentempel, Dschungeltempe: Find a desert temple, jungle temple or witch hut and tick this off. &6YUNG's Better Desert Temples&r, &6Jungle Temples&r and &6Witch Huts&r turn them into big complexes.
Finde eines der kleinen Bauwerke von &6F: Find one of the small structures from &6Formations Nether&r and tick this off.
Finde eines dieser Bauwerke und hak ab:: Find one of these structures and tick this off: &6Creeping Crypt&r, &6Undead Crypt&r, &6Stray Fort&r, &6Illager Manor&r, illager hideout, &6Toxic Lair&r, jungle or desert ruins.
Find one of these structures and tick this off: &6Nether Keep&r, &6harbour&r at a lava lake, &6piglin donjon&r, piglin outpost and piglin camp, or a &6skeleton tower&r.
Findest du Verhülltes in einer Truhe, ni: If you find something veiled in a chest, take it along. On the day the stage opens it shows its name and you can use it right away.
Fleisch und Leder ohne Schwert, die Kälb: Meat and leather without a sword, the calves stay.
Flexibel: das Werkzeug nimmt oft keinen: Flexible: the tool often takes no damage.
Fluid into items and out again.
Folge der Reihe oben von links nach rech: Follow the row at the top from left to right: secure a base, collect cobblestone, go to the obelisk, deliver. You know Minecraft; this is only about what is different on Kronwerke.
Follow the treasure map to the cross.
Formlos mit &6Laub&r wird es zum &6Horn: Shapeless with &6leaves&r it becomes the &6Horn of the Canopy&r, which clears leaves, with a &6snowball&r the &6Horn of the Covering&r for snow.
Formlos: &6Buch&r (oder das Notizbuch),: Shapeless: &6book&r (or the notebook), &6iron sword&r, &6iron pickaxe&r, &6iron axe&r, &6iron shovel&r.
Formlos: &6Sternbunkel-Charme&r und &6Wa: Shapeless: &6Starbuncle Charm&r and a &6water wheel&r from Create.
Formlos: &6gebratenes Hähnchen&r, zwei &: Shapeless: &6cooked chicken&r, two &6baked potatoes&r, two &6carrots&r, &6onion&r, &6egg&r, &6bread&r and &6bowl&r.
Formlos: eine &6Erde&r, zwei &6Stroh&r,: Shapeless: one &6dirt&r, two &6straw&r, two &6bone meal&r, four &6tree bark&r. Or dirt, two straw, two rotten flesh and four bone meal.
Framed Drawers in your building style.
Freunde in deine Chunks lassen, ohne ein: Let friends into your chunks without sharing a team.
Früher oder später schaust du ohnehin in: Sooner or later you will look into the three big chapters anyway: &6Create&r, &dArs Nouveau&r and &aBotania&r. Have fun in the Kronwerke.
Funktioniert wie das Glas der Leere: In: Works like the Void Jar: in the hotbar it destroys the items on its list as you pick them up. Instead of mana it gives a little &dexperience&r for them.
Funktionsblumen ziehen Mana aus dem näch: Functional flowers draw mana from the nearest &6Mana Pool&r within &e10 blocks&r. A spreader can't supply them directly.
Fäll &e16 Karmesinstiele&r im &6Karmesin: Fell &e16 crimson stems&r in the &6crimson forest&r. The wood doesn't burn and is good building timber.
Fell &e16 warped stems&r in the &6warped forest&r. This wood doesn't burn either.
Führ das Band im Kreis, dann drehen unfe: Run the belt in a loop, then incomplete parts do their three rounds on their own. A funnel with a filter pulls off finished mechanisms.
Fünf &6Andesitlegierungen&r in U-Form er: Five &6Andesite Alloys&r in a U shape make a &6Basin&r. It takes items and fluids, by hand, through a chute, a funnel or a pipe.
Fünf &6Eisenbleche&r und zwei &6Andesitl: Five &6Iron Sheets&r and two &6Andesite Alloys&r make a &6Whisk&r: alloy at the top, sheet, alloy, sheet in the middle, three sheets at the bottom.
Five groups, one chapter per mod.
Für Klingen: Gezackt erhöht den Schaden,: For blades: Jagged raises the damage the more worn the blade is.
Für den &6Natural Altar&r brauchst du dr: The &6Natural Altar&r needs three. How to get the daisy is at the very beginning of the chapter &aBotania&r.
Für die Präzisionslinie brauchst du drei: For the precision line you need three: cogwheel, tube, nugget.
Für die Welt musst du dir keine Sorgen m: You don't need to worry about the world: &6FTB Backups&r backs up the server every &e2 hours&r while someone is online and keeps the last twelve backups.
Für ein &6Steinwerk-Getriebe&r brauchst: Besides the &6Infused Iron&r, a &6Stoneworks Gearbox&r needs four &6Andesite Casings&r, a &6Large Cogwheel&r, a &6Mechanical Press&r, a &6Millstone&r and a &6Water Wheel&r.
For a rod made entirely of iron.
Für weite Wege: Die &6Schlauchrolle&r sa: For long distances: the &6Hose Pulley&r sucks up to 128 blocks deep, and a lake with over 10,000 blocks counts as infinite. Pipes and pump are in the &6Create&r chapter (fluids).
Gedüngtes Ackerland mit Grün gibt mehr E: Farmland fertilized with green gives more yield. Both fertilizers together make the best field.
Gegenstände einer Stufe, die noch nicht: Items of a stage that is not open yet are drawn &eveiled&r: a dark slot with a question mark, whether in your inventory, a chest or JEI. The tooltip says &7???&r, with &cOpens in stage 2 (Brass Works).&r and &8You can carry it, not use it yet.&r below.
Gegessen geben sie Mana-Regeneration. Al: Eaten, they give mana regeneration. As &6Sourceberry Pie&r or &6Sourceberry Roll&r they are the best food for the Mycelial Sourcelink, and Starbuncles harvest ripe bushes on their own.
Geh durch das &6Portal am Spawn&r. Es wu: Go through the &6portal at spawn&r. It was lit on stream with the event for &estage 2&r, and since then the Nether is open to everyone.
Geh in eine &6Taverne&r von Dungeons and: Go into a Dungeons and Taverns &6tavern&r. A villager there trades &e14 emeralds&r and a &6compass&r once for a map to a structure.
Geh mit einem &6Leeren Lohenbrenner&r in: Walk up to the spawner with an &6Empty Blaze Burner&r in hand and right click a live &6blaze&r. It lands in the cage, and you have a &6Blaze Burner&r.
Genau so ist es gemeint: Aufheben und la: That is exactly how it is meant: you may pick up and store everything. Holding, wearing, placing or crafting only works once the stage is open. If such an item lands in your hand, it moves back into your inventory by itself.
Gesperrte Items zeigen im Tooltip, wann: Locked items show in the tooltip when they open. You may already collect them.
Gesät wird einmal von Hand. Danach läuft: You sow once by hand. After that the field runs as long as the bearing turns. Bearing, gantry and harvester are in the &6Create&r chapter (contraptions).
Gain or loss at a glance.
Geworfen hinterlässt es an der Wand, wo: Thrown, it leaves a track of solid vines on the wall where it hits, which you can climb up. Handy on cliffs and in caves.
Gezielt findest du sie erst mit Enderaug: You only find them on purpose with eyes of ender, and those need blaze powder from the Nether (stage 2). The End portal inside only opens in stage 4.
Gib einem Alakarkinos am Strand eine &6T: Give an Alakarkinos on the beach a &6pottery sherd&r and it gives you a token. In the apparatus with a &6brush&r and &e3 pottery sherds&r it becomes the charm.
Gib einem wilden &dFlashjack&r (Archwood: Give a wild &dFlashjack&r (archwood forests, high peaks) a &6Flashpine&r. In the apparatus: token, &e2 Air Essences&r, &e2 gold ingots&r.
Gib einer wilden &dSirene&r in warmen Me: Give a wild &dSiren&r in warm oceans a &6sea pickle&r and it drops tokens. In the apparatus with prismarine shards, 3 fish and &e3 Source Gems&r it becomes the charm.
Gib ihm einen Namen, den andere wiederer: Give it a name others will recognise. It also comes mossy, in sandstone, deepslate and more; JEI shows every variant.
Gib ihn dem Brenner, und er ist eine Wei: Give it to the burner, and it is &csuperheated&r for a while. An arm or a funnel tops it up.
Gold am Kopf, Schild in der Hand, Bruchs: Gold on your head, shield in hand, cobblestone in the bag.
Gold ist hier unten Währung: Piglins tau: Down here gold is currency: piglins trade all sorts of things for it (bastions section).
Goldnuggets, ein Tintenbeutel, eine &6En: Gold nuggets, an ink sac, an &6ender pearl&r and paper make three &6Warp Scrolls&r. Each opens the list of all your waystones once.
Gold powder in a circle, stands around it.
Grab &664 Andesit&r. Er liegt in großen: Dig &664 andesite&r. It sits in large veins in the stone, often next to granite and diorite. Any pickaxe will do.
Grab auf &eY 15&r lange Tunnel und bau &: Dig long tunnels at &eY 15&r and mine &e4 ancient debris&r. It doesn't glow, is blast proof and floats on lava as an item.
Grab eine große &6Erzader&r an und bring: Dig into a large &6ore vein&r and bring a &6block of raw copper&r along. The veins run through the stone as long bands, in the mining world too.
Grab ganz unten, knapp über dem Grundges: Dig all the way down, just above bedrock, until you have &e8 diamonds&r. Ultimine takes the whole vein in one go.
Große Fische geben mehr Filets. &6Gräten: Big fish give more fillets. &6Fish bones&r, which you sometimes pull out, turn into bone meal in the crafting table.
Große Kontraptionen ohne Kleber an jeder: Big contraptions without glue at every corner.
The base for pasta and stew.
Grundlage für Podeste, Arkanen Kern und: The base for pedestals, Arcane Core and apparatus. The stonecutter has many variants for building, and with Ars Additions also doors, buttons and walls.
Gräbt wie die Schaufel, aber 3x3. Ideal: Digs like the shovel, but 3x3. Ideal for building sites and sand deserts.
Bigger, and the Elder Guardians are waiting.
Gut als Puffer neben einer einzelnen Fun: Good as a buffer next to a single functional flower. Wherever the Lexica talks about Mana Pools, it always means the big one.
Hoe, shovel and axe for the farm.
Hak ab und zieh los. Die Quests hier zei: Tick this and set out. The quests here show you how to find your way, travel fast, dig in the mining world and what waits in the structures.
Hak ab, wenn du Biome findest, zwischen: Tick this off when you find biomes, travel between waystones, dig in the mining world and know which structures belong where.
Half the speed, twice the power.
Halt Rechtsklick gedrückt, und alles Gew: Hold right click, and all plant growth around you is torn out and drops what it would drop by hand: tall grass, flowers, ripe crops.
Halt Rechtsklick, bis er geladen ist, da: Hold right click until it is charged, then you pick an activated waystone. After that it needs a cooldown, shown in the tooltip.
Halt ein &6Goldnugget&r in der Hand, dan: Hold a &6gold nugget&r in your hand and the wild Starbuncle won't run away. Throw it to it, it disappears and leaves &6Starbuncle Shards&r behind.
Halte &eShift&r, dann zeigt Jade mehr De: Hold &eShift&r and Jade shows more details. &eNumpad 1&r hides and shows the window, &eNumpad 0&r opens the settings.
Halte &e`&r (links neben der 1) gedrückt: Hold &e`&r (left of the 1) while you break a block. All matching blocks next to it come along: ore veins, trees, a row of stone.
Halte den Bruchstein in der Hand und mac: Hold the cobblestone and &eright-click&r the obelisk. The whole stack goes in and is credited to you.
Halte über einem Create-Block im Inventa: Hold &eW&r over a Create block in your inventory or in JEI. The &6Ponder&r view opens, a small animated guide to exactly that block.
Trade, beds and often a waystone.
Handwerkseinheiten-Rezept mit &6Messingb: Crafter recipe with &6brass sheets&r, &6copper spools&r, &6iron rod&r, alloy and a &6capacitor&r (zinc and copper sheet with a redstone torch).
Handwerkseinheiten-Rezept mit Kupferspul: Crafter recipe with copper spools, capacitors, brass casing, brass sheets and an Electron Tube. It charges items on a depot or belt below with FE.
Handwerkseinheiten-Rezept: &6Andesitlegi: Crafter recipe: &6andesite alloy&r, &6precision mechanism&r, three &6fluid pipes&r, two &6copper ingots&r. The air comes from the copper backtank.
Handwerkseinheiten-Rezept: &6Pins&r (zwe: Crafter recipe: &6pins&r (two copper nuggets), two &6coal&r, &6copper sheet&r, two &6andesite alloys&r, &6shaft&r and &6andesite casing&r make the &6generator collector&r. It goes at the end of the rotor, 8 SU per RPM.
Handwerkseinheiten-Rezept: Messingbarren: Crafter recipe: brass ingots, brass sheets, iron bars, an &6emerald&r and a shaft. Pump &bspawn fluid&r into it and give it rotation.
Handwerkseinheiten-Rezept: fünf &6Widers: Crafter recipe: five &6resistor coils&r on top, below them &6copper sheets&r and a &6conductive casing&r make the &6boiler heater&r. Put it under a basin, like a Blaze Burner.
Handwerkseinheiten-Rezept: vier &6Andesi: Crafter recipe: four &6andesite alloys&r, four &6copper coils&r, one &6shaft&r make the &6generator induction rotor&r. Place it behind the coupling.
Handwerkseinheiten-Rezept: vier &6Eisenb: Crafter recipe: four &6iron sheets&r, six &6copper coils&r, two &6magnets&r, one &6shaft&r and one &6conductive casing&r make the &6electric motor&r.
Hast du eine Taste schon selbst geändert: If you already changed a key yourself, your binding stays. You then rebind doubled keys yourself.
Hast du mehrere offen, nimm den Knopf &e: If you have several open, use the &eClaim all rewards&r button at the bottom edge of the book. If your inventory is full, the reward drops to the ground in front of you.
Herstellen kannst du Verhülltes nicht, d: You cannot craft veiled items; the crafting table then says &7You can't craft that yet&r.
Hier bist du. Offen: Oberwelt und Minend: This is where you are. Open: the Overworld and the mining dimension, Create up to andesite (water wheel, millstone, press, mixer without heat, belts, fans), Ars Nouveau for beginners, Botania up to the Mana Pool, Nature's Aura, Mystical Agriculture inferium.
All the special flowers are made here.
People help each other here. Really.
Hier leben &6Hoglins&r und Piglins. Die: &6Hoglins&r and piglins live here. The glowing &6shroomlights&r in the crowns are bright light without power.
This is where the season is organized.
Hier: &6Enchantment Industry&r (Erfahrun: Here: &6Enchantment Industry&r (experience as a fluid), &6Power Grid&r (circuits with volts and amps), &6Crafts & Additions&r (FE from rotation) and the first parts of &6Create Connected&r.
Hinter &dSchaden&r mehr Schaden, hinter: Behind &dHarm&r more damage, behind &dBreak&r one more mining level, behind Mageblock the block stays. You can place it several times, each one costs extra mana.
Hoglins stoßen dich weit weg, auch über: Hoglins knock you far away, even over cliffs. &6Warped fungi&r scare them off: a few of them at your camp keep them away.
Hol dir zwei &dQuelljuwelen&r aus der &a: Get two &dSource Gems&r from the Ars Nouveau &aImbuement Chamber&r, made yourself or from a magician.
Holz und Eisen geben Flexibel II, Knoche: Wood and iron give Flexible II, bone +20 percent damage. Stone rods are Brittle II, better not.
Holz, Stein, Wasserräder, die ersten Zau: Wood, stone, water wheels, the first spells.
Holzkohle brauchst du für Endoflammen, F: You need charcoal for Endoflames, torches and the furnace. With fire instead of lava, the fan smokes food instead.
Horte &6Kupfer&r und &6Zink&r im Verhält: Hoard &6copper&r and &6zinc&r at a ratio of two to one, and press &6Iron Sheets&r ahead of time.
Hält Ringe, Amulette, Charmes und Scherb: Holds rings, amulets, charms and shards. Opens with a key from the hotbar or curio slot. With blaze powder it becomes the larger Spellcaster Bag from stage 2.
Hält länger als ein normaler Bogen und r: Lasts longer than a normal bow and repairs itself with mana as soon as you carry a Mana Tablet from stage 2.
Häng Rohre an den Verbund: Hook pipes up to the network
Hängt das Spiel beim Laden lange, ruckel: If the game hangs for a long time while loading, stutters briefly every few seconds or crashes with &7OutOfMemory&r, Minecraft has too little &ememory&r. In &6Prism Launcher&r you set it under &eEdit Instance, Settings, Java&r, in the &6Modrinth App&r in the instance options under &eJava and memory&r.
Hör Musik unterwegs: Listen to music on the road
Hühner in der Nähe legen ihre Eier hinei: Chickens nearby lay their eggs into it instead of into the grass. You need eggs for dough, fried rice and roast chicken.
Im &6Infusionsaltar&r: eine Prosperiumsa: In the &6Infusion Altar&r: a prosperity seed base, 4 &6Inferium Essence&r, 4 stone (smelted). The &6Stone Seeds&r on farmland, &6Growth Accelerators&r below. 8 &6Stone Essence&r in a ring give &e24 cobblestone&r.
Im &6Zauberbuch für Anfänger&r stecken s: The &6Novice Spell Book&r already holds five glyphs: &dProjectile&r, &dTouch&r and &dSelf&r as forms, &dBreak&r and &dHarm&r as effects. It can only use &etier 1&r glyphs.
Im Apparat: &6Archwood-Stamm&r in die Mi: In the apparatus: &6archwood log&r in the middle, &e4 Source Gems&r, &e2 gold ingots&r, &fAir Essence&r, &6Manipulation Essence&r on the pedestals.
Im Apparat: &6Dominion-Zauberstab&r, daz: In the apparatus: &6Dominion Wand&r, plus a &6block of amethyst&r and &e2 gold ingots&r.
Im Apparat: &6Glasflasche&r in die Mitte: In the apparatus: &6glass bottle&r in the middle, &6Allow Item Scroll&r, &6furnace&r, &6cobblestone&r, &6coal&r and &6lapis lazuli&r on the pedestals.
In the apparatus: &6glass bottle&r in the middle, &6lava bucket&r, &6bucket&r, &6Allow Item Scroll&r and &6ender pearl&r on the pedestals.
In the apparatus: &6glass bottle&r in the middle, &6leather boots&r and a &6powder snow bucket&r on the pedestals.
In the apparatus: &6glass bottle&r in the middle, &e2 Abjuration Essences&r, a &6Source Gem block&r and a &6gold block&r on the pedestals.
Im Apparat: &6Manipulationsessenz&r in d: In the apparatus: &6Manipulation Essence&r in the middle, &6gold ingot&r, &6piston&r, &6slime block&r and &6diamond&r on the pedestals. It is worn as a curio.
Im Apparat: &6Ring des Potenzials&r in d: In the apparatus: &6Ring of Potential&r in the middle, &e4 diamonds&r, &e2 ender pearls&r and &e2 Source Gems&r on the pedestals.
Im Apparat: &6Sternbunkel-Scherben&r in: In the apparatus: &6Starbuncle Shards&r in the middle, &e4 gold ingots&r on the pedestals. Put the &6charm&r on the ground and it appears.
Im Apparat: &6Stock&r in die Mitte, &e2: In the apparatus: &6stick&r in the middle, &e2 Source Gems&r and &e1 gold ingot&r on the pedestals.
Im Apparat: beliebige &6Samen&r in die M: In the apparatus: any &6seeds&r in the middle, &e4 Source Gems&r on the pedestals. Out comes &6Magebloom seeds&r for farmland.
Im Auswahlrad stellst du Reihenfolge und: In the selection wheel you set the order and the multi mode. In multi mode, a sneaking right click connects all connected blocks, handy for ten chambers at once.
Im Inventar gibt es links den Knopf &eMe: In the inventory there is a &eMy Team&r button on the left, or you use the command &e/ftbteams party create <name>&r. You invite others with &e/ftbteams party invite <player>&r. Team size is not limited.
Im Ofen wird jeder Block zu einer &6Neth: In the furnace each block becomes a &6netherite scrap&r.
Im Rad rennt ein Sternbunkel und treibt: A Starbuncle runs in the wheel and drives your Create machines, without any water. Good for the first andesite line in the middle of your base.
Im Räucherofen wird daraus Räucherschink: In the smoker it becomes smoked ham for the honey glazed ham. At the cutting board, ham gives pork and a bone.
Im Schnitt kostet ein Getriebe &e1,25 Me: On average a mechanism costs &e1.25 brass sheets&r and just under &efour&r each of cogwheels, tubes and iron nuggets. The tubes are the bottleneck.
Im Wirrwald laufen fast nur &6Endermen&r: Almost only &6endermen&r wander the warped forest. For a base in the Nether this is the safest place, and you take the ender pearls along right away.
Im eigenen Tab liegen Eingang, Brennstof: In its own tab there are input, fuel and output like in a furnace, just as fast. Raw iron smelts on the way home that way.
Always the right tool in hand.
Always to the same destination, without levels.
In Höhlen siehst du so den Weg, ohne gle: That way you see the path in caves without placing torches everywhere straight away. Monsters still spawn in moving light: where you stay, place real torches.
In JEI siehst du nur die &enächste&r Stu: In JEI you only see the &enext&r stage, veiled but with its recipe. Later stages stay completely hidden. So you can already stock up on zinc for brass.
In Schiffswracks und Ozeanruinen liegen: Shipwrecks and ocean ruins hold &6treasure maps&r. Follow one to the red cross and dig there for the buried chest. It always contains a &6Heart of the Sea&r.
In Stufe 1 setzt du die Setzlinge noch v: In stage 1 you still replant the saplings by hand. The &6Deployer&r from stage 2 takes that over, see the right side. For small amounts, the pots are quieter and cheaper.
In Stufe 1 sind zwei offen, alle anderen: In stage 1 two are open, all others need runes:
In Stufe 1 will das Ziel &6Bruchstein&r,: In stage 1 the goal wants &6cobblestone&r, &6Andesite Alloy&r and &6Source Gems&r. Everyone has cobblestone, so don't throw it away. You see how far along it is on the &eboss bar&r at the top and with &e/kw goals&r.
In Stufe 2 schießt die &6Lebeholzschleud: In stage 2 the &6Livingwood Slingshot&r (with a Rune of Air) shoots the balls straight ahead without gravity.
In Stufe 2 stecken in jedem Messingbarre: In stage 2 every brass ingot has two copper in it. Hoarding copper pays off.
In Stufe 2 steckt in jeder der vier Elem: In stage 2 there is a powder in each of the four elemental runes. Spare petals become dye, dye becomes powder.
In Stufe 2 verbindet &6Create Central Ki: In stage 2, &6Create Central Kitchen&r connects the kitchen with Blaze Burner, Mechanical Arm and Deployer.
In Stufe 2 wird aus Zink und doppelt so: In stage 2 zinc and twice as much copper make &6brass&r, and the obelisk then wants 2,000 ingots. A chest of raw zinc now is a head start later.
In Stufe 2 wird ein Tank mit Lohenbrenne: In stage 2 a tank with Blaze Burners under it becomes a steam boiler.
In deinen Chunks kann niemand außer dein: In your chunks nobody outside your team can break blocks or open chests. How many chunks you have and how to keep them loaded is in the chapter &6Tips and Tricks&r.
In den &eSteuerungseinstellungen&r gibt: Thanks to &6Controlling&r, the &econtrols settings&r have a &esearch bar&r at the top. Type part of the name, like &ebackpack&r or &eUltimine&r, and you immediately see the matching key.
In den Topf: &6Karotte&r, &6Kartoffel&r,: Into the pot: &6carrot&r, &6potato&r, &6beetroot&r and &6cabbage&r or a cabbage leaf. Plus a bowl.
In den Topf: &6Verrottetes Fleisch&r, &6: Into the pot: &6rotten flesh&r, &6bone meal&r, raw meat and &6rice&r.
In den Topf: ein &6Teigball&r, &6Weißkoh: Into the pot: a &6wheat dough&r, &6cabbage&r, an &6onion&r and raw chicken, pork, beef or a &6brown mushroom&r. Out come &etwo&r dumplings.
In den Topf: eine &6Milchflasche&r, &6Zu: Into the pot: a &6milk bottle&r, &6sugar&r and two &6cocoa beans&r.
In den Truhen: Gold, Diamantausrüstung,: In the chests: gold, diamond gear, ancient debris and the &6smithing template&r for netherite. Thanks to Lootr every player has their own loot.
In den Verbund am Lagerkern gesetzt, nim: Placed into the network at the Storage Controller, the I/O takes items from pipes and hands them out. Input only in, Output only out; both are easy on the server.
In der Haupthand sammelt er nichts. Schl: In your main hand it collects nothing. A sneaking right click on a chest empties it into the chest.
In der Kammer: &6Amethystsplitter&r hine: In the chamber: an &6amethyst shard&r inside, &e3 essences&r of one element and &e3 gold ingots&r on the pedestals, &d5,000 Source&r.
In der Legierungsschmiede gibt ein Purpu: In the Alloy Forge, a block of Crimson Iron with two blaze rods and magma cream gives &ethree&r ingots.
In der Legierungsschmiede: &6Purpur-Stah: In the Alloy Forge: &6Crimson Steel&r, &6Azure Electrum&r, &6crushed shulker shell&r and &6netherite scrap&r: four ingots.
In der Truhe liegen oft Artefakte. &cAbe: The chest often holds artifacts. &cBut:&r About every third chest in a campsite is a Mimic (next quest).
In ihrer Nähe zieht der &6Ring der Magne: Near it, the &6Ring of Magnetization&r (from stage 2) pulls nothing in. Plant it next to the Endoflames, then your ring won't steal the coal.
Inferium, der Infusionsaltar und die ers: Inferium, the Infusion Altar and the first resource seeds. Stone seeds and fire seeds help the stone pillar and the andesite line.
Infused Iron, der Rohstoff für Manastahl: Infused Iron, the raw material for Manasteel.
Innerhalb des Nethers billig, zwischen d: Cheap within the Nether, expensive between worlds.
Ins Becken über einem erhitzten Brenner:: Into the basin over a heated burner: &6leaves&r, &b250 mB water&r and &b250 mB milk&r. The mixer makes &b500 mB tea&r from it. A &6spout&r fills 250 mB each into a &6glass bottle&r: &6Builder's Tea&r.
Ist der Knopf rot, fehlt dir etwas. Fahr: If the button is red, you are missing something. Hover over it and it tells you what.
Ist der Verbrauch größer als die Quellen: If the usage is higher than the sources give, the network is &coverstressed&r and everything stops. Then more source, less speed or a second network helps.
Ist eine Quest erledigt, bekommst du obe: When a quest is done you get the message &eQuest completed!&r at the top right. The reward does not come to you by itself though: open the quest and &eclick the reward&r at the bottom right.
Items, fluid and power in one.
Items auf dem Boden verschwinden nach fü: Items on the ground disappear after five minutes. A Create belt ending over the bed works just as well.
Items fügst du hinzu, indem du das Glas: You add items by using the jar with the item in your off hand, or by putting the jar on the Scribe's Table and clicking the item onto it.
Items schreibst du ein, indem du die Rol: You write items in by putting the scroll on the Scribe's Table and clicking items onto it while sneaking. With Allow the Starbuncle only takes these items, with Deny everything except these.
Items and rotation on one track.
Je &e8 Segel&r bringen &d1 RPM&r, und je: Every &e8 sails&r give &d1 RPM&r, and each RPM carries &d512 SU&r. 32 sails run at 4 RPM and carry 2,048 SU, as much as eight water wheels.
Je tiefer der Fall, desto härter der Sch: The deeper the fall, the harder the blow.

Copper with granite, iron with tuff.
