Mit &6Ei, Karotte und Zwiebel&r wird Rei: With &6egg, carrot and onion&r, rice in the pot becomes &6Fried Rice&r, a full meal. Cooked rice also goes into Steak and Potatoes.
Mit &6Stufe 2 (Messingwerk)&r geht es im: With &6stage 2 (Messingwerk)&r the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter continues: Manasteel, Mana Pearls (only with a brass casing under the pool), Mana Tablet, Runic Altar (with brass ingots) and Terrasteel.
Mit &eStrg+F&r springst du ins Suchfeld: &eCtrl+F&r jumps into the search field at the bottom right. Type part of the name and the list filters at once. &e@create&r shows everything from one mod, for example all blocks from Create.
Mit Apotheosis und vielen Magie-Mods gib: With Apotheosis and many magic mods there are far more enchantments than in vanilla. &6Enchantment Descriptions&r writes what each enchantment does under it in the tooltip.
Mit Farbstoff färbst du sie ein. Ohne Wo: Dye colors them. Without wool there is the &6Sail Frame&r, which counts the same.
Mit Farmer's Delight stapeln sich &6Pilz: With Farmer's Delight, &6mushroom stew&r, &6beetroot soup&r and &6rabbit stew&r stack up to &d16&r, like the meals from Farmer's Delight. They also give &dNourishment&r, and rabbit stew fills you up much more than in vanilla.
Mit Redstone-Signal gibt es die &edoppel: With a redstone signal it passes on &edouble the speed&r to the chain drives next to it, half if it doesn't sit at the source. A weak signal sets values between 1 and 2.
Mit Rotation spannt er sich (&d2 SU pro: With rotation it winds up (&d2 SU per RPM&r). When an item lands on it, it throws it to the target, up to &e32 blocks&r far and to any height, but only straight ahead. If it aims at a chest, it waits until there is room.
Mit Stufe 2 öffnet &6Productive Bees&r:: Stage 2 opens &6Productive Bees&r: an &6Advanced Beehive&r, bees in cages, a &6Centrifuge&r for the combs. Iron, copper, gold, zinc and osmium bees bring in metal while you do something else.
Mit Trichtern oder einer Trichtermalve a: With hoppers or a Hopperhock from stage 2 this becomes a harvest that runs on its own.
Mit Verrottetem Fleisch, Knochen oder Sc: With rotten flesh, bones or gunpowder in the mixer, the random kind becomes zombie, skeleton or creeper. Spawner runes with a soul lantern ignore light.
Mit Weizen aus der Erntemaschine und Meh: With wheat from the harvester and flour from the millstone the whole bakery runs on belts.
Mit allen vier Teilen an tarnst du dich: Wearing all four pieces you disguise yourself as an inconspicuous package while sneaking. Ideal for hide and seek in the package depot.
Mit dem &6Lagerwerkzeug&r (Enderperle, E: With the &6Storage Tool&r (ender pearl, iron ingot, redstone torch, two sticks) click the Storage Controller first, then the link. That way a block of chests in another room hangs on the same controller.
Mit dem &6Runenaltar&r kommen die Blumen: The &6Runic Altar&r brings the flowers that hold farms together: the &6Hopperhock&r collects drops into a chest, the &6Agricarnation&r makes fields and trees grow faster, the &6Rannuncarpus&r replants. For mana, the &6Thermalily&r eats a lava block for 30 seconds, the &6Gourmaryllis&r eats food, preferably varied.
Mit dem Charm trägt dich Pulverschnee, s: With the charm, powder snow carries you instead of you sinking into it. In snowy mountains and groves that saves a lot of trouble.
Mit dem Dominion-Zauberstab an eine Truh: Bind it to a chest with the Dominion Wand, sand or gravel within 3 blocks, Source next to it. It sifts the blocks and puts finds from archaeology loot into the chest.
Mit dem Fokus läuft der Rest des Zaubers: With the focus, the rest of the spell carries on at every block an effect creates, changes or moves. &eFreeze, Break&r freezes water and mines the ice right away.
Mit dem Kit in der Hand wählst du per &e: With the kit in hand you pick the part type with &eZ&r and &eC&r, then kit plus tool into the grid. Tool and part come out separately.
Mit dem Mahlstein davor, der Bruchstein: With the millstone in front that grinds cobblestone into gravel, cobblestone becomes iron nuggets: exactly the nuggets for the alloy.
Off to the hunt with your knife.
Through the tall grass with the knife.
Mit dem Messer schneidest du am Schneide: With the knife you cut on the cutting board, harvest straw from grass and wheat and cut cakes into slices. Pigs you kill with it drop ham.
Mit dem Runenaltar öffnen in &6Stufe 2&r: With the Runic Altar, &6stage 2&r opens: Agricarnation, Jaded Amaranthus, Hopperhock, Rannuncarpus, Clayconia, Exoflame, Tangleberrie, Jiyuulia, Daffomill, Fallen Kanade, Medumone, Tigerseye, Pollidisiac, Marimorphosis, Hyacidus and Vinculotus.
Mit dem Schlüssel öffnest du einen &6Tre: With the key you open a &6Vault&r of the chamber. Every vault gives every player loot once, so the chamber is worth it in a group too.
Mit dem Stab in der Hand siehst du das M: With the wand in hand you see the mana in flowers, spreaders and pools, and the aiming beams of the spreaders.
Mit dem Upgrade im Rucksack fängst du &e: With the upgrade in the backpack you catch &epassive animals&r with a sneaking right click, they end up in a slot of the backpack. That way cows, sheep and chickens move with you to the new base, without lead or fence.
Mit den Manalinsen aus Stufe 2 wird er z: With the mana lenses from stage 2 it becomes a tool that mines blocks or pushes items.
Mit den Runen aus Stufe 2 bekommt der Av: With the runes from stage 2 the avatar gets more rods, such as the Rod of the Skies or of the Hells.
Mit der Roten Karte zerbricht ein Werkze: With the Red Card a tool breaks for good like in vanilla. Every upgrade is fitted at the &6smithing table&r with a &6stick&r as the template.
Mit der Zeit kommen &6Würmer&r heraus. I: Over time &6worms&r come out. Put into the rod, they make the fish bite faster.
Mit einem &6Präzisionsgetriebe&r wird er: With a &6precision mechanism&r it becomes the &6constant speed motor&r: fixed speed, the voltage decides load and direction.
Mit einem Gegenstand am Mauszeiger und g: Dragging over empty slots with an item on the cursor and the &eright mouse button&r held puts one into each slot. The &emouse wheel&r over a stack moves single items back and forth between chest and inventory.
Mit einem Lüfter darunter oder darüber s: With a fan below or above it you can even push items upward.
Mit einer Axt im Werfer entrindet er Stä: With an axe in the dispenser it strips logs on the board and drops the bark.
Monster, die von selbst in den Schacht l: Monsters that walk into the shaft on their own.
Muscle power for trying things out.
Mystical Agriculture hat den Nether mit: Mystical Agriculture has filled the Nether with ore.
Mystische Blumen wachsen in fast allen G: Mystical Flowers grow in almost every grass biome; you recognise them by their sparkles. A flower gives &e2 petals&r at the crafting table, a tall one &e4&r.
Nach 22 Blöcken landen Zombies und Skele: After 22 blocks, zombies and skeletons land with half a heart: one hit is enough, and the experience is yours. From 23 blocks they die on their own, then you get loot but no experience.
Nachts ziehen neben Zombies und Skelette: At night the creatures of &6Born in Chaos&r roam alongside zombies and skeletons, and some of them are tough. Light and walls help as always.
Neben Tonscherben steckt mit &e6,25 Proz: Besides pottery sherds, there is an artifact inside with &e6.25 percent&r. Dungeons and Taverns and the Cataclysm pyramid have their own archaeology.
Nebenzutaten auf Podeste im Umkreis von: Side ingredients on pedestals within &e3 blocks&r, then click the apparatus with the main ingredient. It draws Source from jars nearby.
Neo Origins: 50 Mana mehr, ein Herz weni: Neo Origins: 50 more mana, one heart less.
Neptunium-Spitzhacke und Schaufel graben: The Neptunium pickaxe and shovel dig under water without slowdown, sword and axe hit harder there. Just right for ocean monuments and sunken ships.
Nether Depths Upgrade: Fische, die im Fe: Nether Depths Upgrade: fish that live in fire.
Netheritrüstung brauchst du für die Boss: You need netherite armour for the boss armours further down.
Netheritwerkzeug hält länger, baut schne: Netherite tools last longer, mine faster and don't burn when they fall into lava. Copy the template before you use up the last one.
Netherziegel brauchst du für die Sprengz: You need Nether bricks for the blast bricks of the Immersive Engineering blast furnace. A Create millstone grinds netherrack into cinder flour.
Netherödnis, Karmesin, Wirr, Seelensand,: Nether wastes, crimson, warped, soul sand, basalt.
Neue Biome heißt neue Hölzer, Blumen und: New biomes mean new woods, flowers and plants. Botania needs flowers in every colour, Farmer's Delight wild plants: tomatoes where it is warm, rice in shallow water, cabbage on the coast.
Neue Biome, Wegsteine, Bauwerke voller B: New biomes, waystones, structures full of loot and the mining dimension for digging without holes in the landscape.
Neun &6Tomaten&r im Raster ergeben eine: Nine &6tomatoes&r in the grid make a &6tomato crate&r. Onions, cabbage, carrots, potatoes and beetroot work the same way.
Not everything on the hook is a fish.
Not the same one as for the backpack.
Not everyone wants to join the same team right away. For neighbours there are &eallies&r: in the team window (the &eMy Team&r button in the inventory) you find &eManage Allies&r. There you add players and remove them again.
Nichts wird aus dem Pack entfernt, manch: Nothing is removed from the pack, some things just come later. By the end of the season every mod is within reach. Vanilla is not locked, except the &cNether&r (stage 2) and the &dEnd&r (stage 4).
Nothing is removed from the pack, some things just come later. Vanilla is open, except the &cNether&r (stage 2) and the &dEnd&r (stage 4). Both open with an event.
Niemand ist früher dran, niemand verpass: Nobody is ahead, nobody misses anything because they happened to be offline. You find out the date on &9Discord&r.
Nimm &e8 Netherwarzen&r aus den Treppenh: Take &e8 Nether wart&r from the fortress stairwells and gardens.
Nimm Tränke der Wasseratmung, Milch gege: Bring potions of water breathing, milk against the Elder Guardians' fatigue and doors for air pockets. Sponges and prismarine are the loot.
Nimm einen &6Messingbarren&r aus dem Sta: Take a &6brass ingot&r from the stage's starter pack or mix it yourself. The next quests show how.
Noch nie ein Modpack gespielt? Dann ist: Never played a modpack? Then this chapter is for you. It explains what every other chapter assumes: the &6quest book&r, &6JEI&r, the &6map&r, &6claims&r and &6teams&r, the &6rules&r of Kronwerke and what to do when the game gets stuck.
Nur ein Amulett passt in den Curio-Platz: Only one amulet fits the curio slot. For long mining spells, more mana is usually better.
Only one material for the head.
Only at night, only under open sky.
Nützlich, wenn eine Create-Anlage mehr p: Useful when a Create setup pumps more than you need. Its own filter for up to 9 fluids.
O shows you what you can do.

Ohne Brille baust du blind. Im Raster mi: Without goggles you build blind. Combined with a helmet in the grid they sit firmly on it, and the helmet still protects.
Ohne Glas dauert das erste Juwel ein paa: Without a jar the first gem takes a few minutes. Use the time for the next parts: a Source Jar and a Sourcelink.
Ohne Hitze kann er: zwei Legierungen aus: Without heat it can make: two alloys from andesite and nuggets, &6Dough&r from flour and water, &6Pulp&r for cardboard, &6Mud&r and many shapeless recipes.
Without a log, nobody can help you.
Ohne Runen offen sind &6Tolldorn&r, &6Sc: Open without runes are &6Bellethorne&r, &6Dreadthorne&r, &6Bergamute&r and &6Solegnolia&r. All the others are listed as a checklist in the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter.
No pot, straight from the grid.
Nothing in Botania works without this flower.
Without an outside power source, with a rheostat.
Packt gleiche Items am Boden in ihr 2x2-: Packs identical items on the ground into their 2x2 recipe, like snowballs into snow. The only Ars Technica glyph already open in stage 1. The rest comes with brass in stage 2.
Pergamente füttern ab Stufe 2 die Zauber: From stage 2, parchments feed the spell turrets. Shapeless with a chest, a blank one becomes an &6Allow Item Scroll&r, with cobblestone a &6Deny Item Scroll&r. Both are filters for Starbuncles.
Perlen lassen Endermen fallen, Amethyst: Endermen drop pearls, amethyst grows in the geodes deep down. The dust goes into the Warp Stone and the Warp Plate.
Plant a few saplings at home. Chamber, jar, table and pedestals all need archwood.
Pflanzen auf Reichhaltiger Erde wachsen: Plants on Rich Soil grow faster. With a hoe it becomes Rich Soil Farmland.
Pickup and Magnet Upgrade for chests.
Piglins meiden Seelenfeuer, Seelenfackel: Piglins avoid soul fire, soul torches, soul lanterns and soul campfires. Hoglins avoid warped fungi. Put both at your Nether portal and around your outpost, and it stays quieter.
Pilze wachsen in der Pilzkolonie, Kaninc: Mushrooms grow in the mushroom colony, rabbits you find in deserts and snowy areas.
Pirates, illagers and a sea monster.
Plätze und Upgrade-Plätze auf einen Blic: Slots and upgrade slots at a glance.
Power Grid rechnet mit &dVolt&r, &dAmper: Power Grid calculates with &dvolts&r, &damps&r and &dohms&r. Current only flows in a &eclosed circuit&r: every device has plus and minus, and it needs a way there and back.
Power Grid: Strom im geschlossenen Kreis: Power Grid: power in a closed circuit.
Praktisch beim Erzsuchen: Diamanten lieg: Handy when looking for ore: diamonds lie all the way down, copper veins between Y 0 and 50, iron veins between Y -60 and -8.
Praktisch, solange der Warpstein fehlt o: Handy while the Warp Stone is missing or cooling down.
Press im Fass zu Blöcken: Press into blocks in the barrel

Productive Bees: Waben aus Eisen, Kupfer: Productive Bees: combs of iron, copper and zinc.
Projektil, Brechen. Klick, und der Block: Projectile, Break. Click, and the block is gone.
Trial chambers lie deep in the stone.
Puls-Timer, Pulsierender Verstärker, Pul: Pulse Timer, Pulse Repeater, Pulse Extender.

Quarz mit Redstone, poliert, auf Eisenbl: Quartz with redstone, polished, on an iron sheet.
Quarz und Schwarzstein kommen aus dem Ne: Quartz and blackstone come from the Nether, hence stage 2.
Quelle fließt, der Apparat steht, der Se: Source flows, the apparatus stands, the server waits.
Quellen liefern SU, Maschinen verbrauche: Sources give SU, machines use them.
Quelllinks füllen Gläser, Kammern machen: Sourcelinks fill jars, chambers make gems, a Starbuncle collects them. &6Stage 2&r opens the &6Mage's Spell Book&r, the relays, the ritual brazier and the spell turrets. Continue in the &dArs Nouveau: Mage&r chapter.
Questbuch, JEI, Karte, Claims, Regeln un: Quest book, JEI, map, claims, rules and keys. For everyone who has never played a modpack.
Questbuch, JEI, Karte, Team, Sprachchat,: Quest book, JEI, map, team, voice chat, death.
R for the recipe, U for its uses.

Rechts findest du eine Checkliste der Ba: On the right you find a checklist of the structures in the pack, mod by mod. There are chests almost everywhere; some places are harmless, others guarded.
Rechtsklick auf ein leeres Feld öffnet e: Right-click an empty field to open a grid where you set the recipe. Right-click a filled field to craft it from the ingredients in your inventory, sneaking for up to a whole stack.
Rechtsklick auf eine &6Belohnungstafel&r: Right click a &6Bounty Board&r, take a bounty, collect what is asked for and click the board again with it.
Rechtsklick auf eine platzierte Vanilla-: Right clicking a placed vanilla chest or vanilla barrel turns it into the Sophisticated version, everything stays inside. After that it goes on to copper and iron.
Rechtsklick auf einen &6Wegstein&r aktiv: Right click a &6Waystone&r to activate it. From any waystone you travel to all the ones you have already activated.
Rechtsklick holt das Ergebnis heraus, ei: Right-click takes the result out; an Andesite Funnel on the side pulls it off. Ores are only crushed by the Crushing Wheels from stage 2.
Rechtsklick legt das Item in deiner Hand: Right-click puts the item in your hand into it. Sneak and right-click puts in everything that is not in your hotbar.
Rechtsklick legt ein Item ab, leere Hand: Right click puts an item down, an empty hand takes it back. The apparatus needs up to &e8&r of them, the chamber &e3&r for essences.
Rechtsklick mit &eFarbstoff&r auf einen: Right clicking a brown or red &6mushroom&r with a &edye&r turns it into a &6Shimmering Mushroom&r of that colour. It counts as a petal of the same colour in every recipe.
Rechtsklick mit Amethyst legt ihn hinein: Right click with amethyst puts it inside. The chamber gathers Source very slowly on its own, or quickly from a &6Source Jar&r no more than &e2 blocks&r away.
Rechtsklick mit Juwelen auf den &eObelis: Right click the &eobelisk&r at spawn with gems; sneaking hands in everything that fits. A chest next to it becomes your feeder, &e/kw deposit&r helps on the road.
Rechtsklick mit dem Band auf eine volle: Right click a full chest with the tape, then mine it. It drops as one item with its contents. One roll holds several uses; the tooltip shows what is left.
Rechtsklick mit dem Upgrade auf die Schu: Right clicking the drawer with the upgrade installs it. It pulls &e4 items every 4 ticks&r from the block on one side. You choose the side in the menu (right click the frame) by right clicking the upgrade.
Rechtsklick mit leerer Hand holt das zul: Right click with an empty hand takes back the last thing thrown in. Lexica and JEI show which flower needs which petals.
Rechtsklick öffnet die Liste aller Biome: Right click opens the list of all biomes. Pick one, and it shows direction, distance and coordinates of the nearest. It doesn't wear out.
Rechtsklicke ein &6Andesitgehäuse&r mit: Right click an &6andesite casing&r with a &6zinc ingot&r, or let a deployer do it. It becomes a &6conductive casing&r.
Rechtsklicke eine &6Lohe&r mit dem leere: Right click a &6blaze&r with the empty burner in hand, right at the spawner in the fortress too. You are holding a &6Blaze Burner&r.
Rechtsklicke einen gesetzten, entrindete: Right-click a placed stripped log with a &6copper ingot&r: it becomes &6Copper Casing&r. It goes into the spout, the drain and the hose pulley.
Right click a placed stripped log with a &6brass ingot&r: it becomes a &6Brass Casing&r.
Redstone hält sie an. Rechtsklick mit de: Redstone stops it. Right click with the wand changes the speed, a sneaking right click the direction.
Redstone in die Ecken, Eisen oben, links: Redstone in the corners, iron on top, left and right, a &6furnace&r at the bottom, the upgrade base in the middle.
Redstone when someone looks at you.
Redstone when a burst flies past.
Reichhaltige Erde wächst 10 Prozent schn: Rich soil grows 10 percent faster than dirt, a tool with &6Efficiency&r in the tool slot another 5 percent per level. Tomatoes, cabbage, onions and rice from Farmer's Delight work the same way.
Reicht dein Mana, wird jeder Pfeil zum Z: If your mana suffices, every arrow becomes a spell arrow with the inscribed spell. In the chamber you make &6augment arrows&r (Amplify, Pierce, Split) for more effect.
Onto the belt, out of the chest.
Reines Gänseblümchen, erzeugende Blumen,: Pure Daisy, generating flowers, Mana Spreaders, Mana Pools. In stage 1 up to the pool, enough for the Mana Diamonds in the Source Keystone.
Reisen mit Schriftrollen kosten auf Kron: Travelling with scrolls costs no levels on Kronwerke. One belongs in every bag that goes into a cave.
Repariert wird mit einem &6Reparaturkit&: Repairs are done with a &6Repair Kit&r. The anvil with the head material works too, but costs levels and is only half as effective.
Rezepte an der Wand, ein Klick pro Stape: Recipes on the wall, one click per stack.
Rezepte mit &cErhitzt&r oder &cÜberhitzt: Recipes marked &cHeated&r or &cSuperheated&r in JEI need a &6Blaze Burner&r under the basin. It comes in stage 2, and brass with it.
Serious power from water and heat.
Rinde ist die Hauptzutat für Organischen: Bark is the main ingredient of Organic Compost.
Ritual des Waldes mit einem &6Eichensetz: Ritual of the Forest with an &6oak sapling&r: 3 &6Livingrock&r (from Botania's Pure Daisy), a Gold Leaf, a gold ingot and a Token of Joy. Out comes the &6Natural Altar&r.
Rohes &6Rindfleisch&r, eine &6Karotte&r: Raw &6beef&r, a &6carrot&r and a &6potato&r into the pot, plus a bowl.
Rohkupfer gibt gewaschen Ton dazu, Rohei: Raw copper gives clay on top when washed, raw iron redstone. Ore blocks mined with Silk Touch give 1.75 crushed ores.
Rohre allein bewegen nichts, dafür brauc: Pipes alone move nothing; for that you need a pump. An open end in water pulls it from the world. A &6Fluid Valve&r (pipe and Iron Sheet) closes the line.
Rosenquarz aufs Band, ein &6Einsatzgerät: Rose quartz on the belt, a &6deployer&r with sandpaper polishes it, two &6crafters&r on top of each other put it on an iron sheet.
Rotation, Förderbänder und die ersten Ma: Rotation, belts and the first machines of the Stone Works.
Rotoren erzeugen Strom, wenn sie sich im: Rotors make power when they turn in a magnetic field. Up to &e8&r rotor parts per generator, each costs &d32 SU per RPM&r.
Rucksack in der Hand, &eSchleich-Rechtsk: Backpack in hand, &esneaking right click&r on a chest, and whatever is in the filter moves into the backpack. Before building: pack torches, slabs and building blocks with one click.
Rucksack in die Hand, &eSchleich-Rechtsk: Backpack in hand, &esneaking right click&r on a chest, barrel or drawer, and the matching items move in. In the filter you set that only items already there are deposited.
Rucksäcke, Schubladen, Truhen und Tresor: Backpacks, drawers, chests and vaults for the first week.
Rucksäcke: Leder 27 und 1, Kupfer 45 und: Backpacks: leather 27 and 1, copper 45 and 1, iron 54 and 2 (stage 2), gold 81 and 3, diamond 108 and 5 (stage 3), netherite 120 and 7 (stage 4).
Rund um die Segel darf nichts im Weg ste: Nothing may be in the way around the sails. You set the direction in the bearing's value box.
Ruten für weitere Lohenbrenner und Braus: Rods for more Blaze Burners and brewing stands, quartz for electron tubes, glowstone for light and the Aether portal.
Seeds and leftovers become bone meal.
Sammelt alle Items am Zielort ein. Setz: Collects all items at the target. Put it &ebehind&r the effect: &eProjectile, Break, Pickup&r. With AOE (tier 2) the radius gets bigger.
Sammle &664 Zinkbarren&r und &6128 Kupfe: Collect &664 zinc ingots&r and &6128 copper ingots&r. Every brass ingot costs two copper and one zinc.
Sammle &e9 Magmablöcke&r an Lavaseen ode: Collect &e9 magma blocks&r at lava lakes or in the basalt deltas and &e4 magma cream&r from the bouncing &6magma cubes&r.
Sammle die Zutaten für das &aRitual des: Collect the ingredients for the &aRitual of the Forest&r: &e4 Infused Iron&r, &e2 Livingwood Twigs&r, &e1 Mana Diamond&r, &e1 Gold Leaf&r.
Sand gibt beim Waschen Ton, roter Sand G: Washing sand gives clay, red sand gold nuggets, flour turns into dough.
Schau dir einen Ort erst von außen an, b: Look at a place from the outside first before you storm in, and tick this off.
Schaufel &e16 Seelensand&r im &6Seelensa: Shovel &e16 soul sand&r in the &6soul sand valley&r. Nether wart grows on soul sand, and it belongs under the Wither.
Schick die &eDatei&r in den Discord, nic: Send the &efile&r to the Discord, not a screenshot of it. Add two sentences: what were you doing, and does it keep happening? Most crashes are sorted out within minutes that way.
Shoots mana from A to B.
Schlag &6Leuchtstein&r von der Decke, bi: Knock &6glowstone&r from the ceiling until you have &e32 glowstone dust&r. Without Silk Touch each block gives 2 to 4 dust.
Schleich-Rechtsklick in die Luft wechsel: A sneaking right click into the air switches the mode. &eBind mode:&r sneak click a spreader, then the target. &eFunction mode:&r a sneak click turns a spreader towards the clicked side.
Schleichen und Rechtsklick mit leerer Ha: Sneak and right-click with an empty hand switches between sending and receiving. That way you switch a clutch at the other end of the base.
Schleusen füllen die Einsatzgeräte nach,: Funnels refill the deployers, the scrap runs back, the mechanisms go into a chest or straight into the intake at the obelisk.
Schlägst du auf einen Block, nimmt es da: When you hit a block, it takes the matching tool from the backpack into your hand: pickaxe, axe, shovel, sword. Works with Silent Gear too.
Schmuck mit den Eigenschaften des Metall: Jewellery with the traits of the metal.
Schnell gemacht und ein Snack für unterw: Made quickly and a snack for the road.
Schnell, leicht, und es schnitzt Vorlage: Fast, light, and it carves Template Boards on the stone anvil. Unlike the crude knife, it can be repaired.
Schneller geht es mit TNT: Netherrack fl: It goes faster with TNT: netherrack flies away, the debris stays. Keep your distance and secure against lava.
Schreckdorn und Vitalic-Quelllink arbeit: Dreadthorne and Vitalic Sourcelink work together.
Schreiter laufen auf Lava herum, oft in: Striders wander around on lava, often in groups. You find saddles in fortresses and bastions.
Schriftrollen, gewöhnliche Tinte und der: Scrolls, common ink and the first spellcaster. A second magic next to Ars Nouveau that already gets going in stage 1.
Pork and leather in the Nether.
Heavier and stronger than a sword.
Sword, axe and sickle in one.
Schützt wenig, aber mit allen vier Teile: Protects little, but with all four pieces Botania's tools and rods cost much less mana and the rods get stronger. It repairs itself with mana from your inventory as soon as you carry a Mana Tablet from stage 2.
Sechs &6getrockneter Seetang&r ergeben e: Six &6dried kelp&r make a &6Belt Connector&r. Click two parallel shafts with it one after the other, up to &e20 blocks&r apart, level or at a 45 degree angle.
Sechs Bretter und Sägemehl aus jedem Sta: Six planks and sawdust from every log, without power.
Six dimensions open with the stages.
Six stacks of arrows in one slot.
Sechs kurze Schritte bis zur ersten Abga: Six short steps to your first delivery at the obelisk.
Sixteen colours, two petals per flower.
Sechzehn Funktionsblumen warten auf Stuf: Sixteen functional flowers wait for stage 2.
Soul fire instead of water or lava.
Seelensand bremst dich. Skelette und Gha: Soul sand slows you down. Skeletons and ghasts see you from far away here, so work quickly and look for cover.
Seelensandtal: langsam, offen und voller: Soul sand valley: slow, open and full of skeletons.
Sehnenfaser ist Flexibel IV, als Bogense: Sinew Fiber is Flexible IV, as a bowstring Flexible II and +20 percent ranged damage.
Seile über einer Tomatenrebe lassen sie: Rope above a tomato vine lets it climb up. You climb it yourself into shafts, and four rope become a &6Safety Net&r against falls.
Seine Drehzahl hängt von der Spannung ab: Its speed depends on the voltage, it supplies &d64 SU per RPM&r. That way a power plant at the river drives a factory at the other end of the base through wires.
Rare, and better kept in the cupboard.
Seltene Tasten liegen auf &eAlt&r, &eStr: Rare keys are on &eAlt&r, &eCtrl&r or &eShift&r plus a letter, for example &eAlt+V&r voice chat menu, &eShift+G&r voice chat groups. The &emouse wheel&r sorts in the inventory and sets a ping in the world; pick block is on &emouse button 5&r instead. Keys marked red in the &econtrols settings&r are bound twice.
Setz &6Reis&r in Wasser, das genau einen: Put &6rice&r into water exactly one block deep with dirt underneath. You find wild rice in swamps and on riverbanks.
Setz den &6Gallkürbis&r auf zwei überein: Put the &6Fel Pumpkin&r on two stacked &6iron bars&r, like a snow golem. A &cblaze&r appears. It is weaker than a real one and drops some &6blaze powder&r instead of a blaze rod.
Setz die &6Brilliant Fiber&r in die Kron: Put the &6Brilliant Fiber&r into the crown of a tree. Over time the leaves turn golden. Fully golden leaves drop &6Gold Leaf&r when broken.
Setz die &6Presse&r über ein &6Becken&r: Put the &6press&r over a &6Basin&r instead of a depot. Two &6flint&r, one &6gravel&r and &b100 mB lava&r get compacted into one &6andesite&r.
Setz dir &eWegpunkte&r an Basis, Erzfund: Set &ewaypoints&r at your base, ore finds, villages and portals. With &eF3&r you see your coordinates; write them down before you go down anywhere.
Setz einem &6Schreiter&r einen &6Sattel&: Put a &6saddle&r on a &6strider&r and steer it with a &6warped fungus on a stick&r (fishing rod plus warped fungus). That way you cross whole lava lakes.
Setz einen &6entrindeten Stamm&r ab und: Place a &6stripped log&r and right-click it with &6Andesite Alloy&r. It becomes &6Andesite Casing&r. Stripped wood works the same way.
Setz einen braunen oder roten Pilz auf R: Put a brown or red mushroom on Rich Soil. It grows into a &6mushroom colony&r.
Setz sie in den Luftstrom eines Lüfters: Put it into a fan's air stream and give it enough power: the air stream gets hot. With higher voltage it smelts items like lava in front of the fan, and faster. The Ponder scene (&eW&r) shows the setup.
Setzt einen leuchtenden Block, der nach: Places a glowing block that disappears after a short time. With &dAmplify&r it stays, &dDispel&r removes it. &eProjectile, Mageblock&r builds steps onto any wall.
Sie angelt wie die Vanilla-Angel, hält a: It fishes like the vanilla rod but lasts as long as its material and can be repaired instead of rebuilt.
Sie bringt dich einmal genau zu diesem W: It takes you once to exactly this waystone, without choosing and, like all scrolls, without level cost. Bind a few to your base and give them to friends.
Sie deckt nur ein Viertel der Fläche ein: It covers only a quarter of the area of a normal map. Open it at your mining level, then you see where you have already been.
Sie füllt Löcher bis 12 Blöcke tief. Ein: It fills holes up to 12 blocks deep. A train with two rollers levels its own track bed.
Sie hat ein &eFilterfeld&r für ein Item: It has a &efilter slot&r for an item or a filter and an adjustable &ecount&r. An &6Attribute Filter&r (brass nugget and wool) filters by properties, such as everything enchanted.
Sie heizt mit Strom aus deinem Netz. Mit: It heats with power from your grid. With enough power it reaches the highest heat level, &csuperheated&r, without any blaze cake.
Sie hält Haken, Köder, Leinen und Schwim: It keeps hooks, bait, lines and bobbers together, and you fit out the rod in it.
Sie hängen hoch über Ebenen, Wäldern und: They hang high above plains, forests and deserts. Build yourself a pillar up and take Feather Falling or a water bucket along.
Sie koppelt Netz und Generatorwelle nur: It only weakly couples grid and generator shaft; a redstone signal changes the strength. It costs &d32 SU per RPM&r.
Sie kostet &d8 SU pro RPM&r. Plan für ei: It costs &d8 SU per RPM&r. For one press at 32 RPM plan a whole water wheel, better two.
Sie lässt &6Böenruten&r fallen. Vier &6W: It drops &6Breeze Rods&r. You can throw the four &6wind charges&r from one rod yourself: thrown at the ground, they fling you up.
Sie löscht alles, was hineinkommt, per H: It deletes everything that comes in, by hand, hopper or belt. Its filter has &e9 slots&r as whitelist or blacklist.
Sie macht Purpur-Stahl, Lohengold, Azur-: It makes Crimson Steel, Blaze Gold, Azure Electrum and Tyrian Steel. Plus &6High-Carbon Steel&r: one iron and three coal, 420 durability and +4 damage.
Sie schießt wie eine Vanilla-Armbrust. M: It shoots like a vanilla crossbow. With Sinew Fiber or Fluffy String as the cord it hits harder.
Sie steckt in Einsatzgerät, Messingschle: It goes into deployer, brass funnel, train signal and display board. Every round of the precision mechanism eats one, and Mekanism makes its first circuit from it.
Sie steckt in Nudeln mit Fleischbällchen: It goes into pasta with meatballs, pasta with mutton chop and fish stew.
It goes into almost every functional flower. A flower with a root in its recipe rests as long as it gets a redstone signal. You harvest grass and ferns with shears.
Sie tut nichts. Rechtsklick streichelt s: It does nothing. Right click pets it, at the anvil it gets a name. Every botanist needs one.
Siehe Kapitel &5Mekanism&r (Rohre und Ta: See the &5Mekanism&r (pipes and tanks) and &cThe Nether&r chapters.
Siehe Kapitel &6Create: Messing&r (Einsa: See the &6Create: Brass&r (Deployer) and &5Mekanism&r (Precision Sawmill) chapters.
Siehe Kapitel &6Create: Messing&r (Mahlw: See the &6Create: Brass&r (crushing wheels) and &5Mekanism&r (Crusher) chapters.
See the &6Create: Brass&r (crushing wheels, Mechanical Spawner), &6Create: Add-ons&r (spawn fluid) and &6Apotheosis&r (runes) chapters.
Siehe Kapitel &aBotania: Runen&r. Der &6: See the &aBotania: Runes&r chapter. The &6Kekimurus&r, which eats cake, comes with Alfheim in stage 3.
Silent-Gear-Werkzeug &everschwindet nich: Silent Gear tools &edon't disappear&r when they break. They stay in your inventory as broken until you repair them.
Sind alle Teile einer Bestellung da, pac: Once all parts of an order are there, it packs them into one new package. That way an order arrives complete and in a fixed order, which matters for machines that need ingredients exactly like that.
Skelett-Türme und Skelett-Lager gibt es: Skeleton towers and skeleton camps come in four styles depending on the biome: wastes, crimson, warped and soul sand. All chests are Lootr chests, so new for every player.
So baust du es: je eine Kiste Andesit un: This is how you build it: one chest each of andesite and nuggets with an Andesite Funnel that puts them on the belt to the basin. A funnel on the side of the basin loads the alloy into an output chest.
That way you are right there with the others. If you need help, ask in chat or in voice chat.
So geht jede Infusion: Gegenstand hinein: Every infusion works like this: item in, and as long as there is enough mana it is transformed piece by piece. JEI shows every recipe with its price under the Mana Pool.
So holt ein Kolben einen Block ab und se: That way a piston picks up a block and sets it down somewhere else, for sliding doors or a storage that swaps chests.
So läuft ein Mixer nur alle paar Minuten: That way a mixer only runs every few minutes, or a dispenser fires on a fixed beat.
So merkst du, ob eine Leitung überhaupt: That way you notice whether a line carries any mana at all, or count bursts with a counter.
So siehst du beim Spielen, wie viele Bar: That way you see how many ingots are still missing while you play, without opening the book. &eUnpin&r removes it again.
So wird die Spitzhacke vom ersten Tag St: That way the day one pickaxe gets better piece by piece. Only the head can't be swapped like this.
Sonnenlicht in der Flasche, dann das ers: Sunlight in a bottle, then your first ritual.
Spawner stehen in Verliesen, Minen und a: Spawners stand in dungeons, mines and as rogue spawners freely in caves. Runes and spawn eggs are in the &6Apotheosis&r chapter.
Spitzen Tropfstein findest du in Tropfst: You find pointed dripstone in dripstone caves. Several dripstones next to each other, each over its own cauldron, and an &6Item Drain&r or a bucket collects the lava.
Pickaxe, axe and shovel in one.
Spitzhacke, Axt, Schwert und Hammer, all: Pickaxe, axe, sword and hammer, all from Silent Gear. You decide the material.
Später wird er im Apparat zum &6Ring des: Later, in the apparatus, it becomes the &6Ring of Greater Discount&r.
Stack-Upgrades ändern nicht die Zahl der: Stack upgrades don't change the number of slots but how much fits into &eeach&r. The starter tier takes &e1.5 times&r as much; 64 stone per slot become 96.
Stahl in Mengen, Erzverdreifachung, Lage: Steel in bulk, ore tripling, storage networks with Applied Energistics and Refined Storage, Alfheim, Afrit and Marid, machines that run around the clock.
Stapel in die Hand, Rechtsklick auf den: Stack in hand, right-click the obelisk.
Statt eines geraden Luftstroms verteilt: Instead of a straight air stream the nozzle spreads the fan's effect all around onto mobs and players. Good for keeping mobs away from a spot or sucking them together.
Steck ein Schaf in den Rucksack: Put a sheep in the backpack
Goes into generator, motor and magnet.
Steh an einer &6Werkbank&r, such das Rez: Stand at a &6crafting table&r, find the recipe with &eR&r and click the small &e+&r at the bottom right of the recipe. JEI puts the ingredients from your inventory into the right slots. &eShift&r-click fills a whole stack.
Stehen sie sich mit ein bis zwei Blöcken: When they face each other one or two blocks apart, the contraption stops and swaps items. A funnel on the fixed one pulls them off. In stage 2 freight trains load this way too.
Stein am Gänseblümchen wird zu &6Lebeste: Stone at the daisy becomes &6Livingrock&r. You need &e5&r for every Mana Pool, &e4&r for the Runic Altar in stage 2, &e8&r for every Mana Tablet.
Endless stone, even while you talk.
Stein, Holz, Weizen und Leder, ohne dass: Stone, wood, wheat and leather, without you standing next to it.
Stell &64 Dampfmaschinen&r an einen groß: Place &64 Steam Engines&r on a big boiler and &64 Blaze Burners&r below. The Engineer's Goggles show the &eboiler level&r and what is missing: heat, water or size.
Stell &64 Seelensand&r als T auf und set: Set up &64 soul sand&r as a T and put &63 wither skeleton skulls&r on top. The &cWither&r appears, explodes and flies off. It drops a &6Nether star&r.
Stell &6Tropfsteinblöcke&r um das Reine: Put &6dripstone blocks&r around the Pure Daisy, they become &6calcite&r.
Stell &bSeelenfeuer&r direkt vor einen &: Put &bsoul fire&r right in front of an &6Encased Fan&r: fire on &6soul sand&r or a &6soul campfire&r. The air stream &5haunts&r whatever flies through.
Stell &cLava&r direkt vor den Lüfter und: Put &clava&r right in front of the fan and send items on a belt through the stream. They are smelted like in a furnace: raw zinc into zinc ingots, sand into glass.
Stell Glas und Link höchstens &e5 Blöcke: Place jar and link no more than &e5 blocks&r apart, the chamber no more than &e2 blocks&r next to the jar. Throw logs next to the link.
Stell Kompost hin und warte. Pilze, Pods: Place compost and wait. Mushrooms, podzol, mycelium or more compost nearby speed it up.
Stell Tresore aneinander, sie verschmelz: Place vaults against each other, they merge into one. Footprint up to &e3 by 3&r, length up to three times the width. That is up to 81 blocks and &e1,620 stacks&r in one inventory.
Stell das Item und den Vorrat ein. Fällt: Set the item and the stock. If it drops below, the gauge orders the ingredients from the network and sends them by package. Several gauges connected make whole chains.
Stell den Tank auf und treib ihn an (4 S: Place the tank and power it (4 SU per RPM) until it holds &e900&r air. With helmet and boots you breathe under water and sink quickly to the bottom.
Stand in the portal for a moment.
Stell ein &6Quellglas&r in höchstens &e5: Place a &6Source Jar&r within &e5 blocks&r and the animal farm supplies Source for your Imbuement Chamber on the side. You find the link in the &dArs Nouveau&r chapter.
Stell eine &6Truhe&r oder ein &6Fass&r h: Place a &6chest&r or a &6barrel&r at most &e3 blocks&r from the obelisk. It becomes your &6feeder&r: every &e2 seconds&r the goal takes out what it needs and credits it to you.
Stell einen &6Wegstein&r an einen sicher: Place a &6Waystone&r in a safe spot, for example next to your portal or at a fortress.
Stell einen &6Werfer&r vor das Schneideb: Place a &6dispenser&r in front of the cutting board and put a &6knife&r in it. Every redstone signal uses the knife on whatever is lying on the board.
Stell ihn hin und schneide Stücke mit de: Place it and cut slices off with the knife. Four milk bottles come from one milk bucket and four glass bottles.
Stell sie als Raster auf, eine pro Rezep: Set them up as a grid, one per recipe slot, and point their arrows at an output crafter with the wrench. Ingredients in, rotation on, and when every slot is filled they start.
Stell sie zwei Blöcke hoch neben die End: Place it two blocks high next to the Endoflames, chest and hopper above it.
Sternbunkel leben in bewaldeten Gegenden: Starbuncles live in wooded areas, often in archwood forests.
Stirbst du, bleibt dein &6Körper&r mit a: When you die, your &6body&r stays where it is with everything you had on you. Walk back, &eright click&r the body, take your things. It never disappears as long as something is in it, and turns into a skeleton after an hour, contents and all.
Stolper über eine &6Festung&r und hak ab: Stumble upon a &6stronghold&r and tick this off. &6YUNG's Better Strongholds&r builds them bigger, with libraries, prisons and traps.
Power for items on the belt.
Power instead of rotation, 80 blocks far.
Strom, Werkzeug und Rüstung, Transport u: Power, tools and armor, transport and storage, dimensions and travel: one line per thing, one checkmark, sorted by stage. For looking things up, not for working through.
Stufe 2 ist offen, Create bekommt seine: Stage 2 is open, Create gets its second half.
Stufe 2: Lohenbrenner, Messing, Präzisio: Stage 2: Blaze Burner, brass, precision mechanisms, the Brass Heart and the Create addons.
Stufe 2: hinein, Rohstoffe, Biome, Festu: Stage 2: in, resources, biomes, fortresses, bastions and the bosses Ignis and Netherite Monstrosity.
Stufe 3 und alles danach bleibt unsichtb: Stage 3 and everything after it stays invisible until its turn. That way you always see how much is coming, but the list is not flooded with things that are still weeks away.
Logs on the ground, the bar goes up.
Stämme durch heiße Luft, Kohle für die E: Logs through hot air, coal for the Endoflames.
Stämme geben mehr Bretter als in der Wer: Logs give more planks than in the crafting table, and it can do every stonecutter recipe. With several results you choose with a &6List Filter&r (iron nuggets and wool).
Stürzt das Spiel ab, öffne im Launcher d: If the game crashes, open the &einstance folder&r in the launcher. In it is &elogs/latest.log&r with everything the game did last, and in the &ecrash-reports&r folder a file with the date and time of the crash.
Such dir einen Platz, bau was Festes hin: Pick a spot, build something solid and secure it: &eM&r opens the map, &eC&r the claim view. Hold the &eleft mouse button&r and drag across the chunks of your base.
Such eine &6Netherfestung&r und bring &e: Look for a &6Nether fortress&r and bring &e16 Nether bricks&r out. Keep a lookout from above for dark walls over the lava lakes.
Such mit dem Kompass der Natur einen &dA: Look for an &darchwood forest&r with the Nature's Compass and tick this off when you stand in it.
Suppen und Eintöpfe geben meist Komfort,: Soups and stews usually give Comfort, big meals usually Nourishment. The duration is in the tooltip.
Suppen und Eintöpfe geben meist den Effe: Soups and stews usually give the &dComfort&r effect, see the quest after this one.
Thousands of one kind in one block.
Technik braucht Magie, Magie braucht Tec: Tech needs magic, magic needs tech.
Technik, Magie oder beides. Der Server b: Tech, magic or both. The server needs both.
Teil die Oberwelt-Koordinaten deines Zie: Divide the overworld coordinates of your destination by &e8&r, go there in the Nether and build a portal. One block in the Nether counts as eight up top.
Termine für die Finale der Stufen und Ev: Dates for the stage finales and events are posted there first.
Deep down, fireproof, worth every effort.
Tief unter der Erde findest du sie manch: Deep underground you sometimes find them in small patches too.
Tiere in der Nähe fressen daraus und ver: Animals nearby eat from it and breed on their own. Leather, meat and wool come along on the side.
Tomaten klettern an Strohseilen hoch und: Tomatoes climb up rope and bear fruit along their whole height. You need them for sauce, salad and burgers.
Trag ihn auf dem Rücken oder in der Hand: Wear it on your back or carry it in your hand; &eB&r opens it. How to make it bigger later is in the chapter &6Storage&r.
Treffer über 20 werden gekappt, mehr als: Hits over 20 are capped, no more than 14 per second get through, and from 15 blocks away you barely do damage. It heals from its hits. Fire resistance, golden apples and lots of people.
Tresore haben keine Oberfläche. Du fülls: Vaults have no screen. You fill and empty them with funnels, chutes, belts or packages.
Trichter am Boden sammeln Knochen, Pfeil: Hoppers on the floor collect bones, arrows, flesh and gunpowder. An &6Encased Fan&r pushes hesitant monsters to the hole.
Trichter oben, Trichter unten, und du ge: Hopper on top, hopper below, and you go to sleep.
Trifft ein Manastoß die Trommel, reißt s: When a mana burst hits the drum, it tears out all plant growth around it, just like the horn. It stores no mana, so it needs a &6Pulse Mana Spreader&r on a redstone clock.
Drinks water and turns it into mana.
Trog, Nest und Markt stehen im Kapitel &: Trough, nest and market are in the &6Food and Farming&r chapter (animals and market).
Truhe, Trichter, Offene Kiste über den E: Chest, hopper, Open Crate above the Endoflames. A &6pressure plate&r under the drop spot locks the hopper while coal is still lying there, so never too much falls.
Truhen und Fässer nehmen fast dieselben: Chests and barrels take almost the same upgrades as the backpack. A finished upgrade can be converted between backpack and storage; JEI shows the recipes.
Tut ein Zauber nicht, was er soll, schau: If a spell doesn't do what it should, check the order of the augments first.
Töpfe, Böden und Werkzeugplatz stehen im: Pots, soils and the tool slot are in the &6Cooking&r chapter (botany pots).
Killing without mana, spawning without a spawner.
Um die Ecke kommst du nur mit Zahnrädern: You only get around a corner with cogwheels or a gearbox. The wrench turns a placed shaft.
Und umgekehrt: Wenn dich jemand im Chat: And the other way round: if someone asks you in chat how a water wheel works, answer. That is how Kronwerke works.
Unter einem Becken glimmt er nur. Mit Of: Under a basin it only smoulders. With furnace fuel (coal, wood) it is &cheated&r, with a &6Blaze Cake&r &csuperheated&r for a while. A funnel or an arm feeds it.
Unter einem Becken heizt er den Mixer fü: Under a basin it heats the mixer for &6brass&r. How it continues is in the &6Create: Brass&r chapter.
Unter einem Becken nimmt das Becken imme: Under a pool, the pool always accepts and destroys whatever no longer fits. That way Endoflames keep running instead of leaving coal lying around.
Unterwegs schlafen, ohne den Spawnpunkt: Sleep on the road without losing your spawn point.
Upgrades stecken links neben dem Rucksac: Upgrades go left of the backpack inventory. The leather backpack has only one slot, so you swap them depending on the day: mining, building, farming.
Verbinde sie mit dem &6Dominion-Zauberst: Connect it to your Petal Apothecary (or a cauldron) with the &6Dominion Wand&r. When the apothecary is empty, the urn refills it for a little Source.
Verbindet, dreht und misst alles in Bota: Binds, rotates and measures everything in Botania.
Verbrenn &e32 Holzkohle&r. Holzkohle aus: Burn &e32 charcoal&r. Charcoal from tree farm and furnace is the fuel that never runs out.
Verletzt mit Mana ständig alle Lebewesen: Constantly hurts all living things nearby with mana, except players. Under a spawner it kills without a weapon.
Verletzt nur &eausgewachsene Tiere&r, Ju: Only hurts &eadult animals&r, the young ones stay. In a pen with a hopper underneath it supplies meat and leather on its own. More animal farms in the &aFirst Farms&r chapter.
Verzauberte Bücher kosten viel Erfahrung: Enchanted books cost a lot of experience, but then one good enchantment is enough for the whole server.
Viele Dörfer haben einen &6Wegstein&r un: Many villages have a &6Waystone&r and a &6Bounty Board&r. Don't build right in the middle and keep the villagers alive; the rest of the server trades with them too.
Viele Quests geben &6Kisten&r: &7Steinki: Many quests give &6crates&r: &7Stone Crate&r, &fIron Crate&r and &6Gold Crate&r, better in that order. Right-click opens them. A Gold Crate waits at the end of this chapter.
Viele Waffen und Rüstungen aus Truhen un: Many weapons and armour pieces from chests and monsters carry Apotheosis &6affixes&r. The colour of the name shows the rarity: &7Common&r, &aUncommon&r, &9Rare&r, &5Epic&r, &6Mythic&r.
Vier &6Andesitgehäuse&r um ein &6Großes: Four &6Andesite Casings&r around a &6Large Cogwheel&r make two &6Chain Conveyors&r. Put them on powered shafts and connect them with &6chains&r, up to &e32 blocks&r, up to four connections per conveyor.
Vier &6Eisenbarren&r im Quadrat oben rec: Four &6iron ingots&r in a square at the top right, a &6brick&r at the bottom left as the handle.
Vier &6Kupferdraht&r, zwei &6Karton&r un: Four &6copper wire&r, two &6cardboard&r and one &6stick&r make a &6copper coil&r.
Vier &6Messingbleche&r und eine &6Andesi: Four &6brass sheets&r and one &6andesite alloy&r make a &6Brass Hand&r: alloy on top, three sheets in the middle, one at the bottom.
Vier &6Zahnräder&r um ein &6Andesitgehäu: Four &6Cogwheels&r around an &6Andesite Casing&r make a &6Gearbox&r. It takes rotation on one side and passes it to the others, also at 90 degrees.
Vier &6Zuckerrohr&r, Bambus oder Setzlin: Four &6sugar cane&r, bamboo or saplings with &b250 mB water&r in the mixer make &6Pulp&r, the press turns it into &6Cardboard&r. Four cardboard are a &6Cardboard Block&r.
Vier Abende, an denen der Server zusamme: Four evenings when the server comes together.
Vier Eisenwerkzeuge werden zu einem Buch: Four iron tools become a book.
Vier Fächer mit je &e8 Stapeln&r, die be: Four compartments with &e8 stacks&r each, the best choice for many kinds: ores, ingots, dyes, mob drops. With the Deposit Upgrade in the backpack you stock the wall with one click per drawer.
Four gem blocks and a Source Jar.
Vier Kupferkabel um eine &6leere Spule&r: Four copper wires around an &6empty spool&r (iron sheets and iron rod, 24 pieces) make a &6copper spool&r.
Four scraps, four gold, one ingot.
Four tools, all made of parts.
Vom ersten Quelljuwel zur ersten Ars-Bas: From the first Source Gem to the first Ars base.
Von Spawn bis zur ersten Abgabe in zehn: From spawn to your first delivery in ten steps, then obelisk, milestones, stages and every chapter of stage 1.
From the chamber into the chest.
Von oben siehst du weit. Dazu baut die M: From the top you see far. On top of that the mod builds wells, bunkers, a trident monument and small combat shrines in five tiers.
Von unten: &6Lohenbrenner&r mit Kohle, &: From the bottom: &6Blaze Burner&r with coal, &6basin&r, one block of air, &6Mechanical Mixer&r. In: &6two copper ingots&r, &6one zinc ingot&r, &6one blaze powder&r.
Vor den Stundenzeiger kannst du ein zwei: In front of the hour hand you can place a second structure that turns as the minute hand. The two must not be glued together. Right click the bearing to start and stop the clock.
Was Stufe 2 bringt und was du jetzt scho: What stage 2 brings and what you can already do now.
Was Verbündete in deinen Chunks dürfen,: What allies may do in your chunks is set in your team's settings, such as breaking blocks or opening chests. That way your neighbour can supply your factory with ore without sharing your quests or your 500 chunks.
Was anbeißt, kommt als lebender Fisch he: Whatever bites comes out as a live fish: &6Searing Cod&r, &6Bonefish&r, &6Glowdine&r, lava pufferfish and more. Some kinds only live in certain biomes, like the &6Soul Sucker&r in the soul sand valley.
What you pick up lands in the backpack.
Was es sonst noch umwandelt: Eis zu Pack: What else it converts: ice to packed ice, packed ice to blue ice, a water source to snow, netherrack to cobblestone, soul sand to sand. The two Nether blocks are available from stage 2.
What else there is for Create.
Was hineinkommt und ein 2x2-Rezept hat,: Whatever comes in and has a 2x2 recipe, it presses into a block right away: quartz, clay, snow. 3x3 like ingots into blocks needs the &6Advanced Compacting Upgrade&r.
Was im Filter steht, wird beim Ankommen: Whatever is in the filter is destroyed on arrival. Good for dirt, gravel, diorite.
Wasser auf dem Spawnerboden schwemmt die: Water on the spawner floor washes the monsters to the shaft. With &6spawner runes&r you change rate, count and range; the &6Frontiersman's Rune&r makes 7 monsters per spawn at 24 blocks activation.
Wasserrad, Wellen und Zahnräder treiben: Water wheel, shafts and cogwheels drive millstone, press and mixer. In stage 1 it goes up to andesite, and that is exactly what fills the tech pillar.
Weck die &cNetherite Monstrosity&r in de: Wake the &cNetherite Monstrosity&r in the forge and defeat it: &e600 health&r, armour 12, lava bombs, flame beam and flare bombs.
Weich bremst das Tempo, je abgenutzter d: Soft slows the speed the more worn the tool is. Enchants well (15).
Weich seinen Fangzähnen aus dem Boden au: Dodge its fangs from the ground and kill the Vexes first. It always drops a &6Totem of Undying&r. Hold it in your off hand and it saves you from death once.
Soft fibers for cord and binding.
Weichen, Kuppler, Dieselmotoren, Spawnfl: Switches, couplings, diesel engines, spawn fluids and the rest are in &6Create: Addons&r.
Weitere Pfeifen auf die gesetzte gesteck: More whistles stacked onto the placed one lower the tone, the wrench switches between 3 octaves.
Weitere Verbindungen stimmst du ab, inde: You tune further links by clicking an old one with them before placing. All of this already works in stage 1, without any power.
Weißt du nicht mehr, wo das war: &eU&r ö: If you can't remember where it was: &eU&r opens the &edeath history&r with dimension, position and time of every death. Write down the coordinates or set a waypoint.
Wenn du nicht weiterkommst: Erst &eR&r u: If you get stuck: first &eR&r and &eU&r in JEI, then the matching &echapter&r in the book, then &echat&r or &evoice chat&r. Thirty people on the server, one of them has surely built that machine already. For anything technical (crash, installation, whitelist) there is the &9Discord&r, and &ekronwerke.com&r has the most common questions and the state of the obelisk.
Wenn sich das Glas sichtbar füllt und di: When the jar visibly fills and the chamber works faster, your first Source is running. From now on amethyst is the only bottleneck.
Wer Kronwerke schon kennt, überfliegt di: If you already know Kronwerke, skim the &eRules&r row and pick up the rest along the way.
Who you are changes how you play.
Wer hindurchläuft, nimmt Schaden. Als Za: Whoever walks through takes damage. As a fence around the base it stops monsters, in a mob farm shaft it helps finish them off.
Wer ihn besiegt, bekommt ein Artefakt. S: Whoever defeats it gets an artifact. Hit a campsite chest once as a test before you open it.
Wer noch nie ein Modpack gespielt hat, l: If you have never played a modpack, read all of it. Everyone else should at least look at the &ekeys&r; some are bound twice.
Wer näher als &e48 Blöcke&r ist, hört di: Anyone closer than &e48 blocks&r hears you, quieter with distance. Whispering reaches 24 blocks. In the menu you create &egroups&r, then your team hears you over any distance.
Wer schon in &6Season 1&r dabei war, nut: If you played in &6Season 1&r, use &e/link&r with your Minecraft name in the Discord and get two spots of your own for friends.
Wer später einsteigt, bekommt die &6Star: Whoever joins later gets the &6starter kits&r of every stage that is already open. With stage 2 that is 16 brass ingots, a Blaze Burner, a Source Jar and 8 Mana Pearls.
Whoever joins later gets the &6starter kits&r of every stage that is already open and catches up quickly. Nobody starts from zero in week four.
Wer später kommt, fängt nicht bei null a: Whoever comes later does not start from zero.
Wer vorsorgt, baut am ersten Tag Messing: Plan ahead and you build brass on day one.
Werkbank oder Steinschneider machen aus: Crafting table or stonecutter turn Livingrock into &6Livingrock Bricks&r, polished and mossy variants, slabs, stairs and walls.
Werkzeug aus Teilen, Materialstufen bis: Tools made of parts, material tiers up to Tyrian Steel.
Werkzeug plus neues Teil ins Raster: das: Tool plus new part in the grid: the part is fitted, the old one comes back.
Werkzeug, Waffen und Rüstung aus Teilen,: Tools, weapons and armor from parts whose material decides the stats. Even the iron tier beats every vanilla iron tool.
Werkzeuge an und aus, auch während der F: Tools on and off, even while moving.
Werte wie beim Holzstiel, Flexibel II. D: Stats like the wooden rod, Flexible II. The difference is the look.
Wie bei allen Cataclysm-Bossen ist Schad: As with every Cataclysm boss, damage per hit and per second is capped, and whoever stands too far away barely hits. In a group they fall much faster. The rules are in the &cOverworld Bosses&r chapter.
Wie beim Wasser füllt sich die Schublade: As with water, the drawer fills on its own. You need obsidian for the backpack Void Upgrade and the drawer Void Upgrade.
Like the barrel, only as a chest.
Wie das Lager-Upgrade, nur mit einem &6K: Like the Deposit Upgrade, only with a &6sticky piston&r on top.
Wie der Apfelkuchen ein Block für den Ti: Like the apple pie, a block for the table. The knife cuts it into slices, four slices in a square make a whole pie again.
Wie der Blumenbeutel, nur mit &e1 Manapu: Like the Flower Pouch, only with &e1 Mana Powder&r in the middle: 5 wool, 1 petal, 1 powder.
Wie der Mülleimer, nur mit einem &6Eimer: Like the trash can, only with a &6bucket&r instead of the chest.
Wie der Vulkanische, aber &6Glitzernde M: Like the Volcanic one, but a &6glistering melon slice&r in the middle.
Wie der Vulkanische, aber &6Pilzsuppe&r: Like the Volcanic one, but &6mushroom stew&r in the middle.
Wie der Vulkanische, aber &6Weizen&r sta: Like the Volcanic one, but &6wheat&r instead of a lava bucket in the middle.
Wie die Beeren selbst geben beide beim E: Like the berries themselves, both give mana regeneration when eaten. A pie before a long mining spell, and the bar fills faster.
Wie die Flüssigkeiten gemischt werden, s: How the fluids are mixed is in &6Create: Addons&r.
Wie die anderen Charms lädt ihn die Imbu: Like the other charms, the Imbuement Chamber recharges it when it is empty.
Wie die der Plünderer, nur aus deinem Ma: Like the pillagers' one, only made of your material.
Wie ein Netherportal, nur aus Grubenrahm: Like a Nether portal, only made of Mine Frames.
Like a blueprint, but only once.
Wie man einen Bruchsteingenerator, eine: How to build a cobblestone generator, an alloy line or a gem setup is shown in the chapter &6First Farms&r.
Wie tief bist du gerade?: How deep are you right now?
Wie viel Leistung sie gerade zieht, zeig: A wattmeter in the line shows how much power it is drawing right now.
Wilde Wegsteine gibt es auch im Nether,: Wild waystones exist in the Nether too, about one every 25 chunks.
Wirf &6Netherrack&r zwischen die Mahlwer: Throw &6netherrack&r between the crushing wheels. Each block gives one &6cinder flour&r, a second with 50 percent.
Wirf ein &6Wilden-Horn&r neben einen wil: Throw a &6Wilden Horn&r next to a wild &dDrygmy&r and it gives you &6Drygmy Shards&r. In the apparatus with fish, wheat, apple, carrot, seeds and &e3 Source Gems&r it becomes the charm.
Wirf einem &6Piglin&r einen &6Goldbarren: Throw a &6gold ingot&r to a &6piglin&r. After a few seconds it throws something back at you.
Wirf einen &6Diamanten&r in ein &6Manabe: Throw a &6diamond&r into a &6Mana Pool&r with at least &d10,000 mana&r. It turns into a &bMana Diamond&r.
Throw an ingot, see what comes.
Wirf farbloses &6Glas&r ins Becken. Jede: Throw colourless &6glass&r into the pool. Each block costs &d150 mana&r and comes back as &6Managlass&r.
Wirf keinen Bruchstein weg. Der Obelisk: Don't throw any cobblestone away. In stage 1 the obelisk wants &e20,000&r from the whole server, and every kind counts: normal, mossy and cobbled deepslate.
Wirf passende Dinge hinein, dann verwand: Throw suitable things in and the pool transforms them (&emana infusion&r). Functional flowers within 10 blocks draw from it, a spreader right next to it fills itself from it.
Wirrwald: türkise Bäume, Endermen, der r: Warped forest: turquoise trees, endermen, the quietest place here.
Wolle und Fleisch sammelt eine Andesitsc: An andesite funnel on the floor or the Hopperhock from Botania collects wool and meat.
Wolle, ohne die Schere in die Hand zu ne: Wool without picking up the shears.
Worauf du schaust, steht oben am Bildsch: What you look at is shown at the top of the screen.
Wüste, Dschungel, Sumpf: YUNG's baut all: Desert, jungle, swamp: YUNG's rebuilds them all.
YUNG's Better Dungeons: Skelette, Zombie: YUNG's Better Dungeons: skeletons, zombies, spiders.
YUNG's Better Mineshafts: jedes Biom bau: YUNG's Better Mineshafts: every biome builds differently.
Zauber aus Glyphen, Quelle, Quelljuwelen: Spells from glyphs, source, Source Gems.
Zauber selbst zusammensetzen, Quellgläse: Build your own spells, Source Jars, Starbuncles and the &aImbuement Chamber&r, the only way to Source Gems for the magic pillar.
Ten obsidian and a flint and steel.
Zeig acht 2x2-Schubladen, zwei Eisenfäss: Show eight 2x2 drawers, two iron barrels, a Storage Controller and an Item Vault.
Zeig, dass es läuft: ein Stapel Bruchste: Show that it runs: a stack of cobblestone from the generator, charcoal from the pots, wheat from the field and leather from the pen, all from farms that work without you.
Zerlegt Silent-Gear-Werkzeug und Vanilla: Breaks Silent Gear tools and vanilla tools down into material. &e0 to 50 percent&r is lost per part.
Drag instead of clicking a hundred times.
Zinkklumpen gehen statt Eisenklumpen in: Zinc nuggets go into Andesite Alloy instead of iron nuggets. That saves your iron for sheets and tools.
Zuhause wachsen sie auf &6Seelensand&r,: At home it grows on &6soul sand&r, without light and without water, in the overworld too. A small field is enough for every potion.
Zum Verkleiden im Raster: erster Platz d: To clad it in the grid: first slot the block for the outside, second for the inside, third the drawer, a fourth block colours the trim. Goes well with andesite casings or stone bricks.
Zurück fährt er, wenn die Drehrichtung w: It retracts when the rotation changes direction, easiest with a gearshift. With a slime ball it becomes a &6Sticky Mechanical Piston&r.
Zusammen mit Windkugeln wird er zur gefä: Together with wind charges it becomes the most dangerous melee weapon of the overworld.
Zwei &6Andesit&r und zwei &6Eisenklumpen: Two &6andesite&r and two &6iron nuggets&r (or zinc nuggets) diagonally across in the 2 x 2 grid make one &6Andesite Alloy&r.
Zwei &6Andesitlegierungen&r über zwei &6: Two &6Andesite Alloys&r above two &6dried kelp&r make two &6Andesite Tunnels&r. Put one on top of a belt.
Zwei &6Andesitlegierungen&r übereinander: Two &6Andesite Alloys&r on top of each other make eight &6Shafts&r. A shaft passes rotation on in a straight line, without loss.
Zwei &6Andesitlegierungen&r, &6Redstone&: Two &6andesite alloys&r, &6redstone&r and two &6logs&r make the &6Cart Assembler&r. When a minecart with a redstone signal runs over it, it takes the glued blocks along.
Zwei &6Eisenbleche&r aus der Create-Pres: Two &6iron sheets&r from the Create press, two &6string&r and a &6stick&r, see JEI.
Zwei &6Eisenbleche&r um ein &6Fass&r erg: Two &6Iron Sheets&r around a &6barrel&r make an &6Item Vault&r. It holds &e20 stacks per block&r; vaults placed next to each other merge, up to 3 x 3 blocks across.
Zwei &6Eisenbleche&r und ein &6Eisenbarr: Two &6Iron Sheets&r and an &6iron ingot&r make four &6Chutes&r. A chute pulls items from chests, millstones or basins above it and lets them fall.
Zwei &6Kupferbleche&r um ein &6Fass&r er: Two &6Copper Sheets&r around a &6barrel&r make a &6Fluid Tank&r with &b8 buckets&r per block. Stacked tanks merge, up to 3 blocks wide and 32 high.
Zwei &6Kupferbleche&r und ein &6Kupferba: Two &6Copper Sheets&r and a &6copper ingot&r make four &6Fluid Pipes&r. They connect by themselves to tanks, basins and other mods' machines.
Zwei &6Mahlwerkräder&r aus den Handwerks: Two &6Crushing Wheels&r from the crafting units, one block apart, turning towards each other: gravel becomes &6sand&r, with 10 percent flint and 5 percent clay on top. The Mekanism &6Crusher&r turns cobblestone into gravel and gravel into sand with power.
Zwei &6Mahlwerkräder&r unter dem Fallsch: Two &6Crushing Wheels&r under the drop shaft hurt everything that falls in, without sword and without mana. The &6Mechanical Spawner&r spawns mobs from &6spawn fluid&r (heated mixer: liquid experience and water), &e100 mB per mob&r at 100 RPM or more. The &6Loot Collector&r at its spawn point catches the loot without a mob ever appearing.
Zwei &6Neptuniumbarren&r und zwei &6Stöc: Two &6Neptunium ingots&r and two &6sticks&r, shaped like any hoe.
Zwei &6Schleimbälle&r, ein &6Eisenblech&: Two &6slime balls&r, an &6Iron Sheet&r and an &6iron nugget&r make &6Super Glue&r. Click one corner, then the opposite one: everything in the frame is glued.
Zwei &6Stroh&r übereinander ergeben &evi: Two &6straw&r on top of each other make &efour rope&r.
Zwei &6Stöcke&r links, vier &6Bretter&r: Two &6sticks&r on the left, four &6planks&r next to them on the right.
Zwei &6Tomaten&r in den Topf, eine Schüs: Two &6tomatoes&r into the pot, a bowl with them.
Zwei Abwandlungen im Apparat: mit &e8 Ab: Two variants in the apparatus: with &e8 Abjuration Essences&r the flask turns into &dAmplify&r (one potion level more, half duration), with &e8 Manipulation Essences&r into &dExtend Time&r (&e50 percent&r longer).
Two ingots per recipe, no powder.
Zwei Fasern ergeben einen &6Flachsstrang: Two fibers make one &6Flax String&r. Flax flowers become blue dye for Blueprint Paper.
Zwei Fächer übereinander mit je &e16 Sta: Two compartments on top of each other with &e16 stacks&r each. Good for pairs: coal and charcoal, iron and copper ingots, seeds and wheat.
Zwei Karten sind im Pack. &eM&r öffnet d: There are two maps in the pack. &eM&r opens the big map of &6FTB Chunks&r, where you also claim your chunks. &eJ&r opens &6JourneyMap&r with the minimap at the top right. Both record what you have seen.
Zwei Räder mit einem Block Abstand, dreh: Two wheels one block apart, turning &etowards each other&r. Whatever falls in from above is crushed. Each wheel costs &d8 SU per RPM&r, so two at 64 RPM cost 1,024 SU.
Zwei Stroh übereinander: vier Strohseile: Two straw on top of each other: four rope. Four straw in a square: one canvas. Nine straw: a straw bale. And straw goes into compost.
Zwei Stufen öffnen mit einem Event, das: Two stages open with an event that runs live on every stream: stage 2 lights the &cNether portal at spawn&r, stage 4 activates the &dEnd portal&r. The &5Ender Dragon&r is the first boss the server fights together.
Two parts copper, one part zinc.
Zwei kleine &6Blumen&r, eine &6Koralle&r: Two small &6flowers&r, a &6coral&r and a &6bone meal&r make two &6Tree Fertilizer&r.
Zwei kleine nebeneinander geben die Dreh: Two small ones side by side pass the rotation sideways and the direction flips. A large one drives a small one offset diagonally and &edoubles&r the speed; the other way round it halves.
Zwei nebeneinander werden eine &eDoppelt: Two next to each other become a &edouble chest&r. Barrels stack more compactly, chests look nicer in living rooms.
Zwei oder drei Mixer aus einem gemeinsam: Two or three mixers fed from a shared vault are a good start for the obelisk goal.
Zweige stecken im Stab des Waldes (3), i: Twigs go into the Wand of the Forest (3), the Livingwood Bow (3), every Manasteel tool and two of them into every Manasteel ritual.
Zweimal am Tag spielt sie eine Melodie:: Twice a day it plays a tune: at noon and in the evening, as soon as you can sleep.
Zwiebeln stecken in gebratenem Reis, Bur: Onions go into fried rice, burgers, stews and almost every big meal.
Zwischen &6Mahlwerkrädern&r gibt eine Ru: Between &6crushing wheels&r a rod gives three powder, with a 25 percent chance of three more. The millstone doesn't grind rods.
Zäune, ein Block &6Erde&r und Bretter, s: Fences, a block of &6dirt&r and planks, see JEI. Fill it with plant leftovers.
Öffne das Kapitel &6Erste Farmen&r. Eine: Open the chapter &6First Farms&r. One farm per quest: cobblestone, wood, wheat, animals, monsters, lava and mana, all with stage 1 means.
Öffne eine Truhe in einem Bauwerk und &c: Open a chest in a structure and &cdon't mine it&r. Thanks to &6Lootr&r it has its own contents for every player.
Öffne links im Buch das Kapitel &6Tipps: Open the chapter &6Tips and Tricks&r on the left of the book. It explains how to claim rewards, find recipes, start a team, set up voice chat and get your things back after dying.
Öffne mit &eM&r die Karte und drück &eC&: Open the map with &eM&r and press &eC&r for the claim view. Dragging with the &eleft mouse button&r claims chunks, dragging with the &eright mouse button&r releases them. In your chunks nobody outside your team can break blocks, open chests or hit animals, and creepers blow up nothing.
Über Depot oder Band wendet es sein Item: Over a depot or belt it applies its item to everything below: sandpaper on rose quartz, planks on shafts for cogwheels. JEI lists everything under &eDeploying&r. It costs &d4 SU per RPM&r.
Über dem Becken arbeitet der Mixer oder: The mixer or the press works above the basin. The result stays in the basin until a funnel on its side takes it out.
Across the lava lakes instead of around them.
